<span class="e23">	কেশব! তুয়া জগত বিচিত্র ।<br /></span>করমবিপাকে,<span class="e22">	ভব-বন ভ্রমই’,<br /></span><span class="e23">	পেখলুঁ রঙ্গ বহু চিত্র ॥১॥</span>
<span class="e11">	keśava! tuyā jagata vichitra</span><span class="e6"><br /></span>karama-vipāke,<span class="e10">	bhava-vana-bhrama-i,<br /></span><span class="e11">	pekhalu̐ raṅga bahu chitra </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">keśava!</span>–O Kṛṣṇa!; <span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">jagata</span>–material world; <span class="e2">vichitra</span>–variegated, strange; <span class="e2">karama</span>–of my actions; <span class="e2">vipāke (karma-chakre)</span>–according to the results (in the cycle of action and reaction); <span class="e2">bhava</span>–the mundane world of repeated birth and death; <span class="e2">vana</span>–in the forest; <span class="e2">bhrama-i (bhramaṇa kariyā)</span>–wandering; <span class="e2">pekhalu̐ (dekhilāma)</span>–I saw; <span class="e2">raṅga (tāmāśā)</span>–hoax (trick, joke); <span class="e2">bahu (nānā)</span>–many (various); <span class="e2">chitra (rakama)</span>–types. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Keśava! Your material creation is extremely varie­gated. I have wandered throughout this forest of birth and death according to the consequences of my actions and seen so many kinds of hoaxes.
তুয়া পদবিস্মৃতি,<span class="e22">	আ-মর যন্ত্রণা,<br /></span><span class="e23">	ক্লেশ-দহনে দহি’ যাই ।<br /></span>কপিল পতঞ্জলি,<span class="e22">	গৌতম কণভোজী,<br /></span><span class="e23">	জৈমিনী, বৌদ্ধ আওয়ে ধাই ॥২॥</span>
tuyā pada-vismṛti,<span class="e10">	ā-mara yantraṇā,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kleśa-dahane dahi’ yāi<br /></span>kapila patañjali,<span class="e10">	gautama kaṇabhojī,<br /></span><span class="e11">	jaimini, bauddha āoye dhāi </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">pada</span>–feet; <span class="e2">vismṛti</span>–forgetfulness; <span class="e2">ā-mara (maraṇa avadhi)</span>–until death; <span class="e2">yantraṇā</span>–tortures;<span class="e2"> kleśa</span>–of suffering; <span class="e2">dahane (jvālāya)</span>–in the fire;<span class="e2"> dahi’ (dagdha ha-iyā)</span>–burning; <span class="e2">yāi</span>–I go; <span class="e2">kapila</span>–teacher of atheistic Sāṁkhya philosophy (systematic analysis of the material elements) who appeared in the lineage of Agnidev; <span class="e2">patañjali</span>–famous ṛṣi who authored the<span class="e3"> Yoga-sūtra </span>(guidelines for aṣṭaṅga-yoga practice); <span class="e2">gautama</span>–author of the<span class="e3"> Nyāya-sūtra </span>(principles of logic); <span class="e2">kaṇabhojī</span>–Kaṇāda, the author of Vaiśeṣika-darśan (atomic theory); <span class="e2">jaimini</span>–the author of Pūrva-mīmāṁsā (theory based on the idea that karma is an absolute principle, unassailable even by God); <span class="e2">bauddha</span>–Buddhists; <span class="e2">āoye (āise)</span>–come; <span class="e2">dhāi (dhāiyā)</span>–running. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> As a result of forgetting Your feet, I am being tortured until my death, burning in a fire of suffering. Meanwhile, Kapila, Patañjali, Gautam, Kaṇabhojī, Jaiminī, and the Buddhists (the proponents of all sorts of ideologies) come running to me.
তব কই’ নিজ মতে,<span class="e22">	ভুক্তি মুক্তি যাচত,<br /></span><span class="e23">	পাতই’ নানা-বিধ ফাঁদ ।<br /></span>সো সবু—বঞ্চক,<span class="e22">	তুয়া ভক্তি-বহির্ম্মুখ<br /></span><span class="e23">	ঘটাওয়ে বিষম পরমাদ ॥৩॥</span>
tava ka-i’ nija mate,<span class="e10">	bhukti mukti yāchata,<br /></span><span class="e11">	pāta-i nānā-vidha phā̐da<br /></span>so sabu—vañchaka,<span class="e10">	tuyā bhakti-bahir-mukha<br /></span><span class="e11">	ghaṭāoye viṣama paramāda </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tava</span>–about You; <span class="e2">ka-i’ (tomāra kahiyā arthāt tomāra dohāi diyā)</span>–explaining (speaking about You, that is, appealing on Your behalf); <span class="e2">nija</span>–their own; <span class="e2">mate (svasiddhānta)</span>–opinions (own conclusions); <span class="e2">bhukti</span>–mundane enjoyment; <span class="e2">mukti</span>–liberation; <span class="e2">yāchata (yāchñā kare arthāt grahaṇa karāibāra janya anurodha kare)</span>–appeal (ask, that is, request me to accept); <span class="e2">pāta-i (pātiyā)</span>–setting; <span class="e2">nānā</span>–various; <span class="e2">vidha</span>–kinds; <span class="e2">phā̐da (jāla)</span>–of traps; <span class="e2">so (tāra)</span>–they; <span class="e2">sabu (sakalei)</span>–all; <span class="e2">vañchaka (pratāraka)</span>–cheaters; <span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotional service; <span class="e2">bahirmukha</span>–averse; <span class="e2">ghaṭāoye (ghaṭāya)</span>–they create; <span class="e2">viṣama</span>–terrible; <span class="e2">paramāda (bhrānti)</span>–illusion. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> Speaking about You according to their own conclusions, they implore me to accept the pursuits of either worldly enjoyment or liberation by setting various types of traps. They are all cheaters who are averse to devotion; they simply devise terrible illusions.
বৈমুখ-বঞ্চনে,<span class="e22">	ভট সো-সবু,<br /></span><span class="e23">	নিরমিল বিবিধ পসার ।<br /></span>দণ্ডবৎ দূরত,<span class="e22">	ভক্তিবিনোদ ভেল,<br /></span><span class="e23">	ভকতচরণ করি’ সার ॥৪॥</span>
vaimukha-vañchane,<span class="e10">	bhaṭa so-sabu,<br /></span><span class="e11">	niramila vividha pasāra<br /></span>daṇḍavat dūrata,<span class="e10">	bhakti-vinoda bhela,<br /></span><span class="e11">	bhakata-charaṇa kari’ sāra </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">vaimukha (vimukha)</span>–averse; <span class="e2">vañchane</span>–for cheating; <span class="e2">bhaṭa (vīra)</span>–warriors (expert fighters); <span class="e2">so-sabu (sei samudaya)</span>–all of them; <span class="e2">niramila</span>–built; <span class="e2">vividha</span>–various; <span class="e2">pasāra (dokāna)</span>–shop; <span class="e2">daṇḍavat (sammāna)</span>–obeisance (gesture of respect); <span class="e2">dūrata (dūra ha-ite)</span>–from afar; <span class="e2">bhakti-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod;<span class="e2"> bhela</span>–became; <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–of the devotees; <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–the feet; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">sāra (sarvasva)</span>–the be-all and end-all. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> All these combatants have set up various shops for cheating those who are averse to You. Bhakti Vinod has offered his respects to them all from afar and accepted the feet of Your devotees as his be-all and end-all.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">4</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> daṇḍavat dūrata … bhakata-charaṇa kari’ sāra: </span>“Bhakti Vinod … has accepted the feet of Your devotees as his be-all and end-all.” This conviction has been expressed by Śrī Deśik Āchārya:
jñānāvalambakāḥ kechit kechit karmāvalambakāḥ<br />vayaṁ tu hari-dāsānāṁ pāda-trāṇāvalambakāḥ
“Some take shelter of the path of knowledge (jñān). Some take shelter of the path of action (karma). We, however, take shelter of the sandals of the Supreme Lord’s servants.”
[Translator’s note: A recapitulation of this song by Śrīla Bhakti Rakṣak Śrīdhar Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj is found in his book <span class="e3">The Search for Śrī Kṛṣṇa</span>:
O my Lord Kṛṣṇa, I see that everything is available in Your world, which has an infinite variegated nature. Separated from You, how­ever, we are always feeling miseries. A continuous flow of suffering has swallowed us from birth to death, and we cannot tolerate the pain of such misery. And so many relief agents—Kapila, Patañjali, Gautam, Kaṇāda, Jaimini, and Buddha—are running towards us, offering their solutions.
Kapila has come with the Sāṁkhya philosophical system of analysis saying, “Analyse matter, and you will be free from all this pain.” Patañjali has come with yoga, “Hey, jīvātma! Come to meet Paramātmā! Then all the problems of this world will go away from you. Come in connection with Paramātmā, the Supersoul.” This is his recommendation.
Gautam comes with logic, Nyāya-śāstra, saying: “There is one Maker, one Creator, but He is indifferent. He has crea­ted this world, finished, and left it. You must try to live with the help of your reason. Develop your reasoning faculty, and be reasonable in all your conduct. Then only can you help yourself in this world. There is no other remedy. Be a good logician, and then you will be able to control the environment with the power of reason, and you will be happy.”
Then Kanāda says: “By chance atoms have combined, and with the dissolution of atoms, nothing will remain. Why do you bother? Don’t care. What is fate? It is nothing; ignore it. And when the body is dissolved, nothing will remain. Why lament?”
Then with the philosophy of Karma-mīmāṁsā, Jaimini says, “There may be One who has connected us with this world and our karma, but karma is all-in-all. He is an indifferent inspector. He has got no hold on us any longer. According to our karma we shall thrive or we shall go down. So, these activities are recommended to you. If you go on with your karma you will be happy. Of course, it cannot be denied; karma-phal, the result of karma, diminishes and is ended. But stick to karma, good karma, don’t go to bad karma. The result of good karma will be finished, but that does not matter; again go on doing good karma, and the good result will await you in heaven, and you will have a happy life. If anything is friendly to you, it is your karma. There is God, but He is indifferent. He is bound to serve you whether good or bad, according to your karma. He has no independence.”
Then another class of philosophy is that of Buddha: “Only the combination of different things has created your mental system. With the dissolution of the mental system, nothing remains. So, somehow, we must dissolve the mental system. Practise ahiṁsa, non-violence, satya, truthfulness, and so on.”
It is seen that all these philosophers are talking either of renunciation or of exploitation (bhukti, mukti). And by setting different types of enchanting traps, they arrange to capture the jīva. Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur says, “But I have come to realise that these fellows are all cheaters. And they all have this common stand: they have no touch of Your devotion, Your service. There, they are one. They cannot deliver any real good. They are common to oppose Your devotional service and supremacy. And ultimately they leave us in chaos.
“But from the ultimate standpoint, I see that they are agents engaged by You to segregate the seriously diseased persons to another ward, for the good of the less seriously diseased patients. It is Your arrangement to segregate the hopeless persons to another side for the benefit of the good side. That is Your design, and they are playing at Your hand like so many dolls. They are Your agents and they are also serving You in some way, because nothing is outside You.” Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur concludes by saying, “I bid goodbye to them all. I feel in my heart that I shall show respect to all these so-called good agents from a distance; however, my only real capital is the dust of the holy feet of Your devotees. I rely on that dust as the source of all my prospects. I seek to put all my energy into taking the dust of their holy lotus feet upon my head. This is everything for me.”]
(২৬)
(26)
তুয়া ভক্তি-প্রতিকূল ধর্ম্ম যাতে রয় ।<br />পরম যতনে তাহা ত্যজিব নিশ্চয় ॥১॥
tuyā bhakti-pratikūla dharma yāte raya<br />parama yatane tāhā tyajiba niśchaya <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable; <span class="e2">dharma</span>–nature; <span class="e2">yāte</span>–in which; <span class="e2">raya</span>–exists; <span class="e2">parama</span>–great; <span class="e2">yatane</span>–with care; <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that; <span class="e2">tyajiba</span>–I will abandon; <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> I will certainly abandon with great care everything that is unfavourable to devotion to You.
তুয়া ভক্তি-বহির্ম্মুখ সঙ্গ না করিব ।<br />গৌরাঙ্গবিরোধি-জন-মুখ না হেরিব ॥২॥
tuyā bhakti-bahirmukha saṅga nā kariba<br />gaurāṅga-virodhi-jana-mukha nā heriba <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">bahirmukha (kṛṣṇa-vimukha janera)</span>–of persons averse (to Kṛṣṇa); <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–association; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Śrīman Mahāprabhu; <span class="e2">virodhi</span>–adverse to; <span class="e2">jana</span>–persons; <span class="e2">mukha</span>–faces; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">heriba</span>–I will see. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> I will not associate with those who are averse to devotion to You. I will not even look at the faces of those who are inimical to Śrī Gaurāṅga.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">2</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> bahirmukha saṅga:</span> “Associate with those who are averse.” This refers to the association of those who are averse to Kṛṣṇa. The extreme to which such association should be abhorred is described in the <span class="e3">Kātyāyana-saṁhitā</span>:
varaṁ hutavaha-jvālā pañjarāntar-vyavasthitiḥ<br />na śauri-chintā-vimukha-jana-samvāsa-vaiśasam
“It is better to endure the pain of being locked in a cage surrounded by blazing fire than keep the distressing association of persons averse to Kṛṣṇa consciousness.”
<span class="e2">gaurāṅga-virodhi:</span> “Persons inimical to Śrī Gaurāṅga.” In his <span class="e3">Śrī Chaitanya-chandrāmṛta </span>(58), Śrī Prabodhānanda Saraswatī writes:
vāso me varam astu ghora-dahana-jvālāvalī-pañjare<br />śrī-chaitanya-padāravinda-vimukhair mā kutrachit saṅgamaḥ
“Let me remain within a cage of blazing fire, but never in the association of persons averse to Śrī Chaitanya’s lotus feet.”
ভক্তিপ্রতিকূল স্থানে না করি বসতি ।<br />ভক্তির অপ্রিয় কার্য্যে নাহি করি রতি ॥৩॥
bhakti-pratikūla sthāne nā kari vasati<br />bhaktira apriya kārye nāhi kari rati <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakti</span>–towards devotion; <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable; <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in a place; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">vasati</span>–residence; <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">apriya</span>–not dear; <span class="e2">kārye</span>–in activities; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">rati</span>–attachment. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> I will not reside in a place that is unfavourable to devotion. I will not have affection for any activities that are unfavourable to devotion.
ভক্তির বিরোধী গ্রন্থ পাঠ না করিব ।<br />ভক্তির বিরোধী ব্যাখ্যা কভু না শুনিব ॥৪॥
bhaktira virodhī grantha pāṭha nā kariba<br />bhaktira virodhī vyākhyā kabhu nā śuniba <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">virodhī</span>–adverse to; <span class="e2">grantha</span>–literature; <span class="e2">pāṭha</span>–read; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">virodhī</span>–adverse to; <span class="e2">vyākhyā</span>–explanations; <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–ever; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">śuniba</span>–I will listen. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> I will not read any literature that is opposed to devotion. I will never listen to any discourses that are opposed to devotion.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">4</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> bhaktira virodhī grantha: </span>“Literature that is opposed to devotion.” Once, when Śrīman Mahāprabhu was describing His day of study to Mother Śachī Devī, He quoted the following verse from <span class="e3">Śrī Mahābhārata </span>about worldly literature:
yasmin śāstre purāṇe vā hari-bhaktir na dṛṣyate<br />śrotavyaṁ naiva tach chhāstraṁ yadi brahmā svayaṁ vadet
“One should never hear a scripture that does not describe devotion to Hari, even if it is recited by Brahmā himself (the original narrator of vedic knowledge).”
গৌরাঙ্গবর্জ্জিত স্থান তীর্থ নাহি মানি ।<br />ভক্তির বাধক জ্ঞান-কর্ম্ম তুচ্ছ জানি ॥৫॥
gaurāṅga-varjita sthāna tīrtha nāhi māni<br />bhaktira bādhaka jñāna-karma tuchchha jāni <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">5</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Śrīman Mahāprabhu; <span class="e2">varjita</span>–bereft of; <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–place; <span class="e2">tīrtha</span>–holy place; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">māni</span>–I consider; <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">bādhaka</span>–obstructing; <span class="e2">jñāna</span>–knowledge; <span class="e2">karma</span>–action; <span class="e2">tuchchha</span>–contemptible; <span class="e2">jāni</span>–I think. [<span class="e24">5</span>]
(5<span class="e14">)</span> I will not consider any place bereft of Śrī Gaurāṅga to be a holy place. I will consider all knowledge and activity that obstruct devotion to be contemptible.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">5</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> bhaktira bādhaka jñāna-karma tuchchha jāni:</span> “I will consider all knowledge and activity that obstruct devotion to be contemptible.” In <span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam</span> (1.5.12), Devarṣi Nārad instructs Vyāsadev:
naiṣkarmyam apy achyuta-bhāva-varjitaṁ<br />na śobhate jñānam alaṁ nirañjanam<br />kutaḥ punaḥ śaśvad abhadram īśvare<br />na chārpitaṁ karma yad apy akāraṇam
“Even pure knowledge (jñān) free from all worldly entanglement is never beautiful if it is devoid of devotion to Achyuta. How, then, can action (karma), which is always miserable, ever be beautiful if it is not offered to Him, even if it is selflessly performed?”
ভক্তির বাধক কালে না করি আদর ।<br />ভক্তি-বহির্ম্মুখ নিজ জনে জানি পর ॥৬॥
bhaktira bādhaka kāle nā kari ādara<br />bhakti-bahirmukha nija jane jāni para <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">6</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">bādhaka</span>–encumbering; <span class="e2">kāle</span>–of times, occasions; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">ādara</span>–fondness; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">bahir</span>–outward;<span class="e2"> mukha</span>–facing; <span class="e2">nija</span>–own; <span class="e2">jane</span>–persons; <span class="e2">jāni</span>–I know; <span class="e2">para</span>–strangers. [<span class="e24">6</span>]
(6<span class="e14">)</span> I will have no fondness for times that are encumbering to devotion. I will consider all my relatives who are averse to devotion to be strangers.
ভক্তির বাধিক স্পৃহা করিব বর্জ্জন ।<br />অভক্ত-প্রদত্ত অন্ন না করি গ্রহণ ॥৭॥
bhaktira bādhika spṛhā kariba varjana<br />abhakta-pradatta anna nā kari grahaṇa <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">7</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">bādhika</span>–opposing; <span class="e2">spṛhā</span>–desires; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">varjana</span>–rejection; <span class="e2">abhakta</span>–non-devotees; <span class="e2">pradatta</span>–given; <span class="e2">anna</span>–food; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">grahaṇa</span>–acceptance. [<span class="e24">7</span>]
(7<span class="e14">)</span> I will abandon all desires that hinder devotion. I will not accept any food presented to me by non-devotees.
যাহা কিছু ভক্তি-প্রতিকূল বলি’ জানি ।<br />ত্যজিব যতনে তাহা এ নিশ্চয় বাণী ॥৮॥
yāhā kichhu bhakti-pratikūla bali’ jāni<br />tyajiba yatane tāhā e niśchaya vāṇī <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">8</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">yāhā</span>–which; <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–something; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotion; <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable;<span class="e2"> bali’</span>–considering; <span class="e2">jāni</span>–I know; <span class="e2">tyajiba</span>–I will reject; <span class="e2">yatane</span>–with care; <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that;<span class="e2"> e</span>–this; <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly; <span class="e2">vāṇī</span>–word. [<span class="e24">8</span>]
(8<span class="e14">)</span> I will carefully abandon whatever I know to be unfavourable to devotion. This is my resolute vow.
ভকতিবিনোদ পড়ি’ প্রভুর চরণে ।<br />মাগয়ে শকতি প্রাতিকূল্যের বর্জ্জনে ॥৯॥
bhakati-vinoda paḍi’ prabhura charaṇe<br />māgaye śakati prātikūlyera varjane <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">9</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakati-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod;<span class="e2"> paḍi’</span>–falling; <span class="e2">prabhura</span>–of the Lord; <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet; <span class="e2">māgaye</span>–begs; <span class="e2">śakati</span>–power;<span class="e2"> prātikūlyera</span>–of what is unfavourable; <span class="e2">varjane</span>–to reject. [<span class="e24">9</span>]
(9<span class="e14">)</span> Falling at the feet of the Lord, Bhakti Vinod prays for the ability to abandon everything unfavourable to devotion.
(২৭)
(27)
বিষয়বিমূঢ় আর মায়াবাদী জন ।<br />ভক্তিশূন্য দুঁহে প্রাণ ধরে অকারণ ॥১॥
viṣaya-vimūḍha āra māyāvādī jana<br />bhakti-śūnya du̐he prāṇa dhare akāraṇa <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–by mundanity; <span class="e2">vimūḍha</span>–bewildered; <span class="e2">āra</span>–and; <span class="e2">māyāvādī</span>–illusionists (those who consider devotion (bhakti), devotees (bhaktas), and the eternal personal Lord (Bhagavān) to be illusory); <span class="e2">jana</span>–persons; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">śūnya</span>–devoid of; <span class="e2">du̐he</span>–both; <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–life; <span class="e2">dhare</span>–maintain; <span class="e2">akāraṇa</span>–in vain. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> Both materialists and illusionists (māyāvādīs) are devoid of devotion and maintain their lives in vain.
এই দুই সঙ্গ নাথ! না হয় আমার ।<br />প্রার্থনা করিয়ে আমি চরণে তোমার ॥২॥
ei dui saṅga nātha! nā haya āmāra<br />prārthanā kariye āmi charaṇe tomāra <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">ei</span>–of these; <span class="e2">dui</span>–two; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–association; <span class="e2">nātha!</span>–O Lord!; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">haya</span>–happen; <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my; <span class="e2">prārthanā</span>–prayer; <span class="e2">kariye</span>–do; <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I; <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> O Lord! At Your feet I pray that I will never associate with these two kinds of offenders.
সে দু’য়ের মধ্যে বিষয়ী তবু ভাল ।<br />মায়াবাদীসঙ্গ নাহি মাগি কোন কাল ॥৩॥
se du’yera madhye viṣayī tabu bhāla<br />māyāvādī-saṅga nāhi māgi kona kāla <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">se</span>–those; <span class="e2">du’yera</span>–of the two; <span class="e2">madhye</span>–between; <span class="e2">viṣayī</span>–materialists; <span class="e2">tabu</span>–still; <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–better; <span class="e2">māyāvādī</span>–illusionists; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–association with; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">māgi</span>–I ask; <span class="e2">kona</span>–any; <span class="e2">kāla</span>–time. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> Between the two of them, however, materialists are better. I never, ever, desire the association of illusionists.
বিষয়ি-হৃদয় যবে সাধুসঙ্গ পায় ।<br />অনায়াসে লভে ভক্তি ভক্তের কৃপায় ॥৪॥
viṣayi-hṛdaya yabe sādhu-saṅga pāya<br />anāyāse labhe bhakti bhaktera kṛpāya <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">viṣayi</span>–of a materialist; <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–the heart; <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when; <span class="e2">sādhu</span>–saintly devotees; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–the association of; <span class="e2">pāya</span>–obtains; <span class="e2">anāyāse</span>–without toil; <span class="e2">labhe</span>–obtains; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">bhaktera</span>–of the devotees; <span class="e2">kṛpāya</span>–by the mercy. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> When the hearts of materialists come into the association of sādhus, they easily attain devotion by the mercy of those devotees.
মায়াবাদ-দোষ যার হৃদয়ে পশিল ।<br />কুতর্কে হৃদয় তার বজ্রসম ভেল ॥৫॥
māyāvāda-doṣa yāra hṛdaye paśila<br />kutarke hṛdaya tāra vajra-sama bhela <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">5</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">māyāvāda</span>–of illusionism; <span class="e2">doṣa</span>–the contamination; <span class="e2">yāra</span>–of whom; <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–in the heart; <span class="e2">paśila (praveśa karila)</span>–entered; <span class="e2">kutarke</span>–with fallacious logic; <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–the heart; <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of him; <span class="e2">vajra</span>–a thunderbolt; <span class="e2">sama</span>–like; <span class="e2">bhela</span>–becomes. [<span class="e24">5</span>]
(5<span class="e14">)</span> Once the contamination of illusionism has entered one’s heart, however, one’s heart becomes as hard as a thunderbolt by the influence of fallacious logic.
ভক্তির স্বরূপ আর ‘বিষয়’, ‘আশ্রয়’ ।<br />মায়াবাদী ‘অনিত্য’ বলিয়া সব কয় ॥৬॥
bhaktira svarūpa āra ‘viṣaya’, ‘āśraya’<br />māyāvādī ‘anitya’ baliyā saba kaya <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">6</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">svarūpa</span>–the true form; <span class="e2">āra</span>–and; <span class="e2">viṣaya (bhajanīya-tattva)</span>–the object (recipient of service—the Lord); <span class="e2">āśraya (bhakta-tattva)</span>–the shelter (the devotee); <span class="e2">māyāvādī</span>–the illusionists; <span class="e2">anitya (naśvara)</span>–non-eternal (transitory); <span class="e2">baliyā</span>–saying; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">kaya</span>–say. [<span class="e24">6</span>]
(6<span class="e14">)</span> The illusionists say that the Lord, His devotees, and devotion itself are non-eternal (and thus illusory).
ধিক্ তার কৃষ্ণ-সেবা শ্রবণ-কীর্ত্তন ।<br />কৃষ্ণ-অঙ্গে বজ্রহানে তাহার স্তবন ॥৭॥
dhik tāra kṛṣṇa-sevā śravaṇa-kīrtana<br />kṛṣṇa-aṅge vajra-hāne tāhāra stavana <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">7</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">dhik</span>–fie!; <span class="e2">tāra</span>–their; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–to Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">sevā</span>–service; <span class="e2">śravaṇa</span>–hearing; <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–and chanting; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">aṅge</span>–at the divine form; <span class="e2">vajra</span>–thunderbolts; <span class="e2">hāne (sachchidānanda vigrahake māyāmaya baliyā kutarkāstra nikṣepa)</span>–strike (saying the Lord’s eternal, conscious, ecstatic form is illusory, they hurl the weapon of their fallacious logic); <span class="e2">tāhāra</span>–their; <span class="e2">stavana</span>–prayers. [<span class="e24">7</span>]
(7<span class="e14">)</span> Fie on their pretence of service to Kṛṣṇa! Fie on their pretence of hearing and chanting Kṛṣṇa’s glories! Their prayers to Kṛṣṇa are like thunderbolts hurled at His divine body.
মায়াবাদ সম ভক্তি-প্রতিকূল নাই ।<br />অতএব মায়াবাদিসঙ্গ নাহি চাই ॥৮॥
māyāvāda sama bhakti-pratikūla nāi<br />ataeva māyāvādi-saṅga nāhi chāi <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">8</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">māyāvāda</span>–with illusionism; <span class="e2">sama</span>–equal; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotion; <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable; <span class="e2">nāi</span>–is not; <span class="e2">ataeva</span>–therefore; <span class="e2">māyāvādī</span>–of illusionists; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–the association; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">chāi</span>–I want. [<span class="e24">8</span>]
(8<span class="e14">)</span> There is nothing more unfavourable to devotion than illusionism. Therefore, I never desire the association of illusionists.
ভকতিবিনোদ মায়াবাদ দূর করি’ ।<br />বৈষ্ণব-সঙ্গেতে বৈসে নামাশ্রয় ধরি’ ॥৯॥
bhakati-vinoda māyāvāda dūra kari’<br />vaiṣṇava saṅgete vaise nāmāśraya dhari’ <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">9</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakati-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod; <span class="e2">māyāvāda</span>–from illusionism; <span class="e2">dūra</span>–far away; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–of the devotees; <span class="e2">saṅgete (vaiṣṇava saṅga-i māyāvāda ha-ite niṣkṛtira upāya)</span>–in the association (the association of devotees is the only way of deliverance from illusionism); <span class="e2">vaise</span>–sits; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–of the Name; <span class="e2">āśraya</span>–the shelter; <span class="e2">dhari’</span>–holding. [<span class="e24">9</span>]
(9<span class="e14">)</span> Keeping illusionism far away, Bhakti Vinod remains in the association of devotees and takes shelter of the Name.
(২৮)
<span class="e2">(28)</span>
আমি ত’ স্বানন্দসুখদবাসী ।<br />রাধিকামাধবচরণ-দাসী ॥১॥
āmi ta’ svānanda-sukhada-vāsī<br />rādhikā-mādhava-charaṇa-dāsī <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I; <span class="e2">ta’</span>–certainly; <span class="e2">svānanda-sukhada (śrī rādhā-kaiṅkaryera kuñja-viśeṣa)</span>–the grove known as ‘Svānanda Sukhada’ (the place of the personal service of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī); <span class="e2">vāsī</span>–a resident; <span class="e2">rādhikā-mādhava</span>–of the Divine Couple; <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–of the feet; <span class="e2">dāsī</span>–a maidservant. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> I am a resident of Svānanda Sukhada Kuñja and a maidservant of Śrī Śrī Rādhikā-Mādhava’s feet.
দুঁহার মিলনে আনন্দ করি’ ।<br />দুঁহার বিয়োগে দুঃখেতে মরি ॥২॥
du̐hāra milane ānanda kari’<br />du̐hāra viyoge duḥkhete mari <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">du̐hāra</span>–of the Divine Couple; <span class="e2">milane</span>–in the meeting; <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–ecstasy; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–I do; <span class="e2">du̐hāra</span>–of the Divine Couple; <span class="e2">viyoge</span>–in the separation; <span class="e2">duḥkhete</span>–by the distress; <span class="e2">mari</span>–I die. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> I rejoice when the Divine Couple are united. I die in distress when They are separated.
সখীস্থলী নাহি হেরি নয়নে ।<br />দেখিলে শৈব্যাকে পড়য়ে মনে ॥৩॥
sakhī-sthalī nāhi heri nayane<br />dekhile śaibyāke paḍaye mane <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">sakhī-sthalī (chandrāvalī pakṣera adhikṛta sthāna)</span>–at the place known as ‘Sakhī Sthalī’ (the place occupied by Chandrāvalī) <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">heri</span>–I look; <span class="e2">nayane</span>–with my eyes; <span class="e2">dekhile</span>–if I see; <span class="e2">śaibyāke (chandrāvalīra pakṣera anugatā sakhī viśeṣa)</span>–to Śaibyā (a friend and follower of Chandrāvalī); <span class="e2">paḍaye</span>–falls; <span class="e2">mane</span>–in my mind. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> I never cast my glance towards Sakhī Sthalī. If I see it, I am reminded of Śaibyā.
যে যে প্রতিকূল চন্দ্রার সখী ।<br />প্রাণে দুঃখ পাই তাহারে দেখি’ ॥৪॥
ye ye pratikūla chandrāra sakhī<br />prāṇe duḥkha pāi tāhāre dekhi’ <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">ye ye</span>–whoever; <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable; <span class="e2">chandrāra</span>–of Chandrāvalī; <span class="e2">sakhī</span>–girlfriends; <span class="e2">prāṇe</span>–in my heart; <span class="e2">duḥkha</span>–distress; <span class="e2">pāi</span>–I get; <span class="e2">tāhāre</span>–of them; <span class="e2">dekhi’</span>–seeing. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> I feel pain in my heart whenever I see any of Chandrāvalī’s unfavourable friends.
রাধিকা-কুঞ্জ আঁধার করি’ ।<br />লইতে চাহে সে রাধার হরি ॥৫॥
rādhikā-kuñja ā̐dhāra kari’<br />la-ite chāhe se rādhāra hari <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">5</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">rādhikā</span>–of Rādhārāṇī; <span class="e2">kuñja</span>–grove; <span class="e2">ā̐dhāra</span>–gloom; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">la-ite</span>–to take; <span class="e2">chāhe</span>–want; <span class="e2">se</span>–they; <span class="e2">rādhāra</span>–of Rādhārāṇī; <span class="e2">hari</span>–Kṛṣṇa. [<span class="e24">5</span>]
(5<span class="e14">)</span> They always want to take away Rādhā’s Hari and enshroud Her grove in gloom.
শ্রীরাধাগোবিন্দ-মিলন-সুখ ।<br />প্রতিকূলজন না হেরি মুখ ॥৬॥
śrī-rādhā-govinda-milana-sukha<br />pratikūla-jana nā heri mukha <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">6</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">śrī-rādhā-govinda</span>–of the Divine Couple; <span class="e2">milana</span>–meeting; <span class="e2">sukha</span>–happiness; <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable; <span class="e2">jana</span>–of persons; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">heri</span>–I look; <span class="e2">mukha</span>–at the face. [<span class="e24">6</span>]
(6<span class="e14">)</span> I never look at the face of anyone who is opposed to the ecstatic union of Śrī Rādhā and Śrī Govinda.
রাধা-প্রতিকূল যতেক জন ।<br />সম্ভাষণে কভু না হয় মন ॥৭॥
rādhā-pratikūla yateka jana<br />sambhāṣaṇe kabhu nā haya mana <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">7</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">rādhā</span>–towards Rādhārāṇī; <span class="e2">pratikūla</span>–unfavourable; <span class="e2">yateka</span>–all; <span class="e2">jana</span>–persons; <span class="e2">sambhāṣaṇe</span>–in conversing; <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–ever; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">haya</span>–is; <span class="e2">mana</span>–in the heart. [<span class="e24">7</span>]
(7<span class="e14">)</span> I never desire to speak with anyone who is inimical towards Śrī Rādhā.
ভকতিবিনোদ শ্রীরাধা-চরণে ।<br />সঁপেছে পরাণ অতীব যতনে ॥৮॥
bhakati-vinoda śrī-rādhā-charaṇe<br />sa̐pechhe parāṇa atīva yatane <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">8</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakati-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod;<span class="e2"> śrī-rādhā</span>–of Rādhārāṇī; <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet; <span class="e2">sa̐pechhe</span>–has surrendered;<span class="e2"> parāṇa (prāṇa)</span>–his life (heart); <span class="e2">atīva</span>–very greatly; <span class="e2">yatane</span>–with care. [<span class="e24">8</span>]
(8<span class="e14">)</span> Bhakti Vinod has surrendered his heart at Śrī Rādhā’s feet with great care.

আনুকূল্যাত্মিকা
<span class="e2">Ānukūlyātmikā:</span> <br />Accepting the Favourable
(২৯)
(29)
তুয়া ভক্তি-অনুকূল যে যে কার্য্য হয় ।<br />পরম যতনে তাহা করিব নিশ্চয় ॥১॥
tuyā bhakti-anukūla ye ye kārya haya<br />parama yatane tāhā kariba niśchaya <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotion; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">ye ye</span>–whatever; <span class="e2">kārya</span>–activities; <span class="e2">haya</span>–are; <span class="e2">parama</span>–great; <span class="e2">yatane</span>–with care; <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–them; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">niśchaya</span>–certainly. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> I will certainly perform with great care all activities that are favourable to devotion to You.
ভক্তি-অনুকূল যত বিষয় সংসারে ।<br />করিব তাহাতে রতি ইন্দ্রিয়ের দ্বারে ॥২॥
bhakti-anukūla yata viṣaya saṁsāre<br />kariba tāhāte rati indriyera dvāre <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotion; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">yata</span>–all; <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–material; <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–in the world; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">tāhāte</span>–for that; <span class="e2">rati (sukhānveṣaṇa)</span>–attach (search for happiness); <span class="e2">indriyera</span>–of the senses; <span class="e2">dvāre</span>–by the gates. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> With my senses, I will take pleasure in those things within the material world that are favourable to devotion.
শুনিব তোমার কথা যতন করিয়া ।<br />দেখিব তোমার ধাম নয়ন ভরিয়া ॥৩॥
śuniba tomāra kathā yatana kariyā<br />dekhiba tomāra dhāma nayana bhariyā <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">śuniba</span>–I will hear; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–about You; <span class="e2">kathā</span>–discussion; <span class="e2">yatana</span>–care; <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–doing; <span class="e2">dekhiba</span>–I will see; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–abode; <span class="e2">nayana</span>–eyes; <span class="e2">bhariyā</span>–filling. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> I will carefully listen to discussions about You. Beholding Your abode, I will fill my eyes.
তোমার প্রসাদে দেহ করিব পোষণ ।<br />নৈবেদ্য তুলসী ঘ্রাণ করিব গ্রহণ ॥৪॥
tomāra prasāde deha kariba poṣaṇa<br />naivedya tulasī ghrāṇa kariba grahaṇa <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">prasāde (uchchhiṣṭe)</span>–with the remnants; <span class="e2">deha</span>–body; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">poṣaṇa</span>–nourishment; <span class="e2">naivedya</span>–offerings; <span class="e2">tulasī</span>–tulasī leaves and flower spikes; <span class="e2">ghrāṇa</span>–smell; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">grahaṇa</span>–acceptance. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> I will maintain my body with Your remnants alone. I will savour the fragrance of the tulasī leaves and mañjarīs that have been offered to You.
কর দ্বারে করিব তোমার সেবা সদা ।<br />তোমার বসতিস্থলে বসিব সর্ব্বদা ॥৫॥
kara dvāre kariba tomāra sevā sadā<br />tomāra vasati-sthale vasiba sarvadā <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">5</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">kara</span>–my hands; <span class="e2">dvāre</span>–with; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">sevā</span>–service; <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">vasati</span>–residence; <span class="e2">sthale</span>–in the place; <span class="e2">vasiba</span>–I will reside; <span class="e2">sarvadā</span>–always. [<span class="e24">5</span>]
(5<span class="e14">)</span> With my hands, I will always engage in Your service. I will always reside in a place where You reside.
তোমার সেবায় কাম নিয়োগ করিব ।<br />তোমার বিদ্বেষি-জনে ক্রোধ দেখাইব ॥৬॥
tomāra sevāya kāma niyoga kariba<br />tomāra vidveṣi-jane krodha dekhāiba <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">6</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">sevāya</span>–in the service; <span class="e2">kāma</span>–desires; <span class="e2">niyoga</span>–employ; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">vidveṣi</span>–those who are inimical; <span class="e2">jane</span>–to the persons; <span class="e2">krodha</span>–anger; <span class="e2">dekhāiba</span>–I will show. [<span class="e24">6</span>]
(6<span class="e14">)</span> I will engage all my desires in Your service. I will show anger towards those who are inimical to You.
এইরূপে সর্ব্ববৃত্তি আর সর্ব্বভাব ।<br />তুয়া অনুকূল হ’য়ে লভুক প্রভাব ॥৭॥
ei-rūpe sarva-vṛtti āra sarva-bhāva<br />tuyā anukūla ha’ye labhuka prabhāva <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">7</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">ei-rūpe</span>–in this way; <span class="e2">sarva</span>–all; <span class="e2">vṛtti</span>–my faculties, my propensities; <span class="e2">āra</span>–and; <span class="e2">sarva</span>–all; <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–thoughts; <span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">ha’ye</span>–being; <span class="e2">labhuka</span>–may obtain; <span class="e2">prabhāva</span>–glory. [<span class="e24">7</span>]
(7<span class="e14">)</span> Having become favourable to devotion in these ways, may all of my actions and thoughts gain glory.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">7</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> tomāra sevāya … labhuka prabhāva: </span>“May all of my actions and thoughts gain glory.” In his <span class="e3">Prema-bhakti-chandrikā</span> (2.10), Śrīla Narottam Ṭhākur describes how one can engage lust, anger, greed, and so forth, in devotional service:
‘kāma’ kṛṣṇa-karmārpaṇe,<span class="e5">	‘krodha’ bhakta-dveṣi-jane,</span>
<span class="e6">	‘lobha’ sādhu-saṅge hari-kathā</span>
‘moha’ iṣṭa-lābha-vine,<span class="e5">	‘mada’ kṛṣṇa-guṇa-gāne,</span>
<span class="e6">	niyūkta kariba yathā tathā</span>
“I will engage my selfish desires by offering my actions to Kṛṣṇa; I will direct my anger towards those inimical to the devotees; I will engage my greed in hearing and discussing the Lord in the association of sādhus; I will become bewildered if I am unable to obtain my beloved master; and I will madly chant Kṛṣṇa’s glories in an intoxicated mood. In this way, I will befittingly engage my enemies in the Lord’s service.”
তুয়া ভক্ত-অনুকূল যাহা যাহা করি ।<br />তুয়া ভক্তি-অনুকূল বলি’ তাহা ধরি ॥৮॥
tuyā bhakta-anukūla yāhā yāhā kari<br />tuyā bhakti-anukūla bali’ tāhā dhari <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">8</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–to the devotee; <span class="e2">anukūla (bhaktera anukūlatā bhagavānera ānukūlyera-i samāna)</span>–favourable (that which is favourable to devotees is as good as that which is favourable to the Lord); <span class="e2">yāhā yāhā</span>–whatever; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">bali’</span>–considering; <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that; <span class="e2">dhari</span>–I hold. [<span class="e24">8</span>]
(8<span class="e14">)</span> Whatever I do that is favourable to Your devotees I consider to be favourable to devotion to You.
ভকতিবিনোদ নাহি জানে ধর্ম্মাধর্ম্ম ।<br />ভক্তি-অনুকূল তার হউ সব কর্ম্ম ॥৯॥
bhakati-vinoda nāhi jāne dharmādharma<br />bhakti-anukūla tāra ha-u saba karma <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">9</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakati-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">jāne</span>–knows; <span class="e2">dharma</span>–piety; <span class="e2">adharma</span>–and impiety; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotion; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">tāra</span>–of him; <span class="e2">ha-u</span>–may be; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">karma</span>–actions. [<span class="e24">9</span>]
(9<span class="e14">)</span> Bhakti Vinod knows neither religion nor irreligion. May all his actions be favourable to devotion.
(৩০)
(30)
গোদ্রুমধামে ভজন-অনুকূলে ।<br />মাথুর শ্রীনন্দীশ্বর সমতুলে ॥১॥<br />তঁহি মাহ সুরভি-কুঞ্জ-কুটীরে ।<br />বৈঠবুঁ হাম সুরতটিনী-তীরে ॥২॥<br />গৌরভকত-প্রিয় বেশ দধানা ।<br />তিলক-তুলসীমালা-শোভমানা ॥৩॥
godruma-dhāme bhajana-anukūle<br />māthura śrī-nandīśvara-sama-tule <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span><br />ta̐hi māha surabhi-kuñja-kuṭīre<br />vaiṭhabu̐ hāma surataṭinī-tīre <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span><br />gaura-bhakata-priya veśa dadhānā<br />tilaka-tulasī-mālā-śobhamānā <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">godruma (abhinna nanda grām)</span>–the island known as ‘Godrum’ (the non-different form of Śrī Nanda Grām of Vraja Dhām); <span class="e2">dhāme</span>–in the abode; <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–devotional service; <span class="e2">anukūle</span>–favourable to; <span class="e2">māthura</span>–of Mathurā (Vraja); <span class="e2">śrī nandīśvara (parvata o tadupasthita grāma)</span>–the mountain and village situated on top of the mountain where Nanda Mahārāj resides; <span class="e2">sama</span>–equal; <span class="e2">tule</span>–in comparison; <span class="e2">ta̐hi (tāra)</span>–there; <span class="e2">māha (mājhe)</span>–within; <span class="e2">surabhi</span>–known as ‘Surabhi’; <span class="e2">kuñja</span>–in the grove; <span class="e2">kuṭīre</span>–in a cottage; <span class="e2">vaiṭhabu̐ (basiba)</span>–will reside; <span class="e2">hāma</span>–I; <span class="e2">surataṭinī (bhagīrathī)</span>–of the Ganges; <span class="e2">tīre</span>–on the bank; <span class="e2">gaura</span>–of Śrīman Mahāprabhu; <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–to the devotees; <span class="e2">priya</span>–dear; <span class="e2">veśa</span>–appearance; <span class="e2">dadhāna (dhāraṇa kariyā)</span>–wearing; <span class="e2">tilaka</span>–markings made with gopī-chandan clay which signify the body to be a temple; <span class="e2">tulasī</span>–of tulasī; <span class="e2">mālā</span>–necklace; <span class="e2">śobhamānā</span>–beautiful. [<span class="e24">1</span>–<span class="e24">3</span>]
(1–3<span class="e14">)</span> In the abode of Godrum, which is most favourable to devotional service and non-different from Śrī Nandīśvar in Śrī Mathurā Maṇḍal, I will reside in a small cottage in Surabhi Kuñj on the bank of the Ganges, wearing tilak, a beautiful tulasī mālā, and the garb most dear to Śrī Gaurasundar’s devotees.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">2</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> surabhi-kuñja:</span> The place where Mārkaṇḍeya Muni obtains the mercy of Śrī Gaura. Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur made a bhajan-kuṭīr here.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">3</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> gaura-bhakta-priya veśa:</span> “Garb most dear to the devotees of Śrī Gaurāṅga.” This refers to the twelve marks of gopī-chandan clay that signify the body to be a temple of the Supreme Lord (tilak), the necklace of tulasī beads worn around the neck, and so on.
চম্পক, বকুল, কদম্ব, তমাল ।<br />রোপত নিরমিব কুঞ্জ বিশাল ॥৪॥
champaka, bakula, kadamba, tamāla<br />ropata niramiba kuñja viśāla <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">champaka</span>–tree known as the <span class="e3">champak</span> (<span class="e3">Magnolia champaca</span> or <span class="e3">Michelia champaca</span>);<span class="e2"> bakula</span>–tree known as the <span class="e3">bakul</span> (<span class="e3">Mimusops elengi</span>); <span class="e2">kadamba</span>–tree known as the <span class="e3">kadamba</span> (<span class="e3">Neolamarckia cadamba </span>or<span class="e3"> Anthocephalus cadamba</span>);<span class="e2"> tamāla</span>–tree known as the <span class="e3">tamāl</span> (<span class="e3">Garcinia xanthochymus </span>or<span class="e3"> Garcinia tinctoria</span>); <span class="e2">ropata (ropaṇa kariyā)</span>–planting; <span class="e2">niramiba</span>–I will make; <span class="e2">kuñja</span>–a grove; <span class="e2">viśāla</span>–great. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> Planting champak, bakul, kadamba, and tamāl trees, I will establish a large grove.
মাধবী, মালতী, উঠাবুঁ তাহে ।<br />ছায়া-মণ্ডপ করবুঁ তহিঁ মাহে ॥৫॥
mādhavī, mālatī, uṭhābu̐ tāhe<br />chhāyā-maṇḍapa karabu̐ tahi̐ māhe <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">5</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">mādhavī</span>–a flowering vine known as <span class="e3">mādhavī</span> (<span class="e3">Hiptage madablota</span> or <span class="e3">Hiptage benghalensis</span>); <span class="e2">mālatī</span>–a flowering vine known as <span class="e3">mālatī</span> (<span class="e3">Aganosma dichotoma</span>); <span class="e2">uṭhābu̐</span>–I will make to climb; <span class="e2">tāhe</span>–there; <span class="e2">chhāyā</span>–shade; <span class="e2">maṇḍapa (nirmita pavitra āśraya sthāna)</span>–pavilion (a pure, constructed, sheltered area); <span class="e2">karabu̐</span>–I will make; <span class="e2">tahi̐</span>–there;<span class="e2"> māhe</span>–within. [<span class="e24">5</span>]
(5<span class="e14">)</span> I will plant mādhavī and mālatī creepers to climb those trees, and in the middle of the grove I will make a shady pavilion.
রোপবুঁ তত্র কুসুমবনরাজি ।<br />যূথি, জাতি, মল্লী বিরাজব সাজি ॥৬॥
ropabu̐ tatra kusuma-vana-rāji<br />yūthi, jāti, mallī virājaba sāji’ <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">6</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">ropabu̐</span>–I will plant; <span class="e2">tatra</span>–there; <span class="e2">kusuma</span>–flowers; <span class="e2">vana</span>–garden;<span class="e2"> rāji (śreṇī)</span>–rows; <span class="e2">yūthi</span>–flower known as <span class="e3">jūthi</span> (<span class="e3">Jasminum molle</span> or <span class="e3">Jasminum auriculatum</span>);<span class="e3"> </span><span class="e2">jāti</span>–flower known as <span class="e3">jāti</span> (<span class="e3">Jasminum officinale</span>); <span class="e2">mallī</span>–flower known as <span class="e3">malli</span> (<span class="e3">Jasminum sambac</span>); <span class="e2">virājaba (virāja karibe)</span>–I will situate;<span class="e2"> sāji’ (sajita ha-iyā)</span>–decorating (being decorated). [<span class="e24">6</span>]
(6<span class="e14">)</span> I will plant rows of various forest flowers there and decoratively arrange jūthis, jātis, and mallīs.
মঞ্ছে বসাওবুঁ তুলসী-মহারাণী ।<br />কীর্ত্তন-সজ্জ তঁহি রাখব আনি’ ॥৭॥
mañche basāobu̐ tulasī-mahārāṇī<br />kīrtana-sajja ta̐hi rākhaba āni’ <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">7</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">mañche (vedī)</span>–on a raised platform (altar); <span class="e2">basāobu̐</span>–I will place; <span class="e2">tulasī-mahārāṇī</span>–the great queen Tulasī Devī; <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–for musical glorification; <span class="e2">sajja (sāja-sarañjāma)</span>–instruments (equipment—mṛdaṅgas, kartāls); <span class="e2">ta̐hi</span>–there; <span class="e2">rākhaba</span>–I will keep; <span class="e2">āni’</span>–bringing. [<span class="e24">7</span>]
(7<span class="e14">)</span> I will place Tulasī Mahārāṇī on a raised platform and keep instruments for kīrtan there.
বৈষ্ণবজন সহ গাওবুঁ নাম ।<br />জয় গোদ্রুম জয় গৌর কি ধাম ॥৮॥
vaiṣṇava jana saha gāobu̐ nāma<br />jaya godruma jaya gaura ki dhāma <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">8</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–devotee; <span class="e2">jana</span>–persons; <span class="e2">saha</span>–with; <span class="e2">gāobu̐ (gāhiba)</span>–I will sing; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name of the Lord; <span class="e2">jaya</span>–<span class="e2">‘</span>all glories’;<span class="e2"> godruma</span>–to Godrumdwīp; <span class="e2">jaya</span>–<span class="e2">‘</span>all glories’; <span class="e2">gaura</span>–of Lord Gaurāṅga; <span class="e2">ki</span>–to; <span class="e2">dhāma</span>–the<span class="e2"> </span>divine abode. [<span class="e24">8</span>]
(8<span class="e14">)</span> In the association of devotees, I will sing the Name. All glories to Godrumdwīp! All glories to the abode of Śrī Gaurāṅga!
ভকতিবিনোদ ভক্তি-অনুকূল ।<br />জয় কুঞ্জ, মুঞ্জ, সুরনদীকূল ॥৯॥
bhakati-vinoda bhakti-anukūla<br />jaya kuñja, muñja, suranadī-kūla <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">9</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakati-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotion; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">jaya</span>–<span class="e2">‘</span>all glories’; <span class="e2">kuñja</span>–grove; <span class="e2">muñja (tṛṇaviśeṣa, śara)</span>–grass, reeds; <span class="e2">suranadī (gaṅgā)</span>–of the Ganges; <span class="e2">kūla (taṭa)</span>–the bank. [<span class="e24">9</span>]
(9<span class="e14">)</span> Bhakti Vinod glorifies all that is favourable to devotion. All glories to the groves, the grass, and the bank of the River Ganges!

শুদ্ধ ভকত-<span class="e25">	চরণ-রেণু,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ভজন-অনুকূল ।<br /></span>ভকত-সেবা,<span class="e25">	পরম-সিদ্ধি,<br /></span><span class="e26">	প্রেমলতিকার মূল ॥১॥</span>
śuddha-bhakata<span class="e10">	charaṇa-reṇu,<br /></span><span class="e11">	bhajana-anukūla<br /></span>bhakata-sevā,<span class="e10">	parama-siddhi,</span><br /><span class="e11">	prema-latikāra mūla </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">śuddha</span>–pure; <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–of devotees; <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–of the feet; <span class="e2">reṇu</span>–dust; <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–to the devotees; <span class="e2">sevā</span>–service; <span class="e2">parama</span>–supreme; <span class="e2">siddhi</span>–fulfilment; <span class="e2">prema</span>–divine love; <span class="e2">latikāra</span>–of the creeper; <span class="e2">mūla</span>–the root. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> Pure devotees’ foot-dust is favourable to devotion. Service to the devotees is the supreme fulfilment and the root of the creeper of prema.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">1</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> śuddha-bhakata charaṇa-reṇu: </span>“Pure devo­tees’ foot-dust.” In <span class="e3">Śrīmad Bhāgavatam </span>(5.12.12), Jaḍ Bhārat advises:
rahūgaṇaitat tapasā na yāti<br />na chejyayā nirvapaṇād gṛhād vā<br />na chchhandasā naiva jalāgni-sūryair<br />vinā mahat-pāda-rajo ’bhiṣekam
“O Mahārāj Rahūgaṇ, regardless of whether one engages in austerities, performs worship according to scriptural guidelines, takes sannyās, follows the religious principles of household life, studies the Vedas, or worships the deities of the natural elements, one can never attain devotion without bathing in the foot-dust of pure devotees.”
Additionally, in <span class="e3">Śrī Chaitanya-charitāmṛta </span>(Antya-līlā, 16.60), it is explained:
bhakta-pada-dhūli āra bhakta-pada-jala<br />bhakta-bhukta-śeṣa—ei tina sādhanera bala
“The dust of the devotees’ feet, the water that has washed the devotees’ feet, and the devotees’ food remnants—honouring these gives one strength to engage in devotional practices.”
মাধব-তিথি,<span class="e25">	ভক্তি-জননী,<br /></span><span class="e26">	যতনে পালন করি ।<br /></span>কৃষ্ণবসতি,<span class="e25">	বসতি বলি’,<br /></span><span class="e26">	পরম আদরে বরি ॥২॥</span>
mādhava-tithi,<span class="e10">	bhakti-jananī,<br /></span><span class="e11">	yatane pālana kari<br /></span>kṛṣṇa-vasati,<span class="e10">	vasati bali’,<br /></span><span class="e11">	parama ādare bari </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">mādhava-tithi</span>–holy days which are especially related to Hari, such as Śrī Harivāsar (Ekādaśī), the appearance day of Kṛṣṇa, and so on; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–of devotion;<span class="e2"> jananī</span>–the mother; <span class="e2">yatane</span>–with care; <span class="e2">pālana</span>–observe; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">vasati (śrī dhāma)</span>–holy abode; <span class="e2">vasati</span>–my dwelling place; <span class="e2">bali’</span>–considering; <span class="e2">parama</span>–great; <span class="e2">ādare</span>–with adoration; <span class="e2">bari (varaṇa kari)</span>–I choose, accept. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> I carefully observe the holy days related to Mādhava; they are the mother of devotion. With great adoration, I embrace Kṛṣṇa’s abode as my own.
গৌর আমার,<span class="e25">	যে সব স্থানে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	করল ভ্রমণ রঙ্গে ।<br /></span>সে সব স্থান,<span class="e25">	হেরিব আমি,<br /></span><span class="e26">	প্রণয়ি-ভকত-সঙ্গে ॥৩॥</span>
gaura āmāra,<span class="e10">	ye saba sthāne,<br /></span><span class="e11">	karala bhramaṇa raṅge<br /></span>se saba sthāna,<span class="e10">	heriba āmi,<br /></span><span class="e11">	praṇayi-bhakata-saṅge </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">gaura</span>–Gaurasundar; <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my; <span class="e2">ye</span>–which; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">sthāne</span>–in the places; <span class="e2">karala</span>–did;<span class="e2"> bhramaṇa</span>–tour; <span class="e2">raṅge (līlāya)</span>–during Pastimes;<span class="e2"> se</span>–those; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">sthāna</span>–places; <span class="e2">heriba</span>–will behold <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I; <span class="e2">praṇayi</span>–loving; <span class="e2">bhakata</span>–of devotees; <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–in the company. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> In the company of loving devotees, I behold all the places my Gaurasundar visited during His Pastimes.
মৃদঙ্গবাদ্য,<span class="e25">	শুনিতে মন,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অবসর সদা যাচে ।<br /></span>গৌর-বিহিত,<span class="e25">	কীর্ত্তন শুনি’,<br /></span><span class="e26">	আনন্দে হৃদয় নাচে ॥৪॥</span>
mṛdaṅga-vādya,<span class="e10">	śunite mana,<br /></span><span class="e11">	avasara sadā yāche<br /></span>gaura-vihita,<span class="e10">	kīrtana śuni’,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ānande hṛdaya nāche </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">mṛdaṅga</span>–of the clay drum; <span class="e2">vādya</span>–sound; <span class="e2">śunite</span>–to hear; <span class="e2">mana</span>–heart; <span class="e2">avasara (suyoga)</span>–opportunity; <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always; <span class="e2">yāche</span>–begs; <span class="e2">gaura</span>–by Śrī Gaurasundar; <span class="e2">vihita (anumata)</span>–prescribed; <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–the musical glorification; <span class="e2">śuni’</span>–hearing; <span class="e2">ānande</span>–with joy; <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–heart; <span class="e2">nāche</span>–dances. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> My heart always begs for the opportunity to hear the sound of the mṛdaṅga. Hearing the kīrtan prescribed by Śrī Gaurasundar, my heart dances with joy.
যুগলমূর্ত্তি,<span class="e25">	দেখিয়া মোর,<br /></span><span class="e26">	পরম আনন্দ হয় ।<br /></span>প্রসাদ-সেবা<span class="e25">	করিতে হয়,<br /></span><span class="e26">	সকল প্রপঞ্চ জয় ॥৫॥</span>
yugala-mūrti,<span class="e10">	dekhiyā mora,<br /></span><span class="e11">	parama-ānanda haya<br /></span>prasāda-sevā<span class="e10">	karite haya,<br /></span><span class="e11">	sakala prapañcha jaya </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">5</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">yugala</span>–of the Divine Couple; <span class="e2">mūrti</span>–Deity form; <span class="e2">dekhiyā</span>–beholding; <span class="e2">mora</span>–my; <span class="e2">parama</span>–great; <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–joy; <span class="e2">haya</span>–happens; <span class="e2">prasāda</span>–of the remnants of food offerings; <span class="e2">sevā</span>–service; <span class="e2">karite</span>–in doing; <span class="e2">haya</span>–happens; <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all; <span class="e2">prapañcha (pañcha-bhūta nirmita jagat)</span>–the universe made of the five material elements; <span class="e2">jaya</span>–conquest. যে দিন গৃহে,<span class="e25">	ভজন দেখি,<br /></span><span class="e26">	গৃহেতে গোলোক ভায় ।<br /></span>চরণসীধু,<span class="e25">	দেখিয়া গঙ্গা,<br /></span><span class="e26">	সুখ না সীমা পায় ॥৬॥</span>
ye dina gṛhe,<span class="e10">	bhajana dekhi,<br /></span><span class="e11">	gṛhete goloka bhāya<br /></span>charaṇa-sīdhu,<span class="e10">	dekhiyā gaṅgā,<br /></span><span class="e11">	sukha nā sīmā pāya </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">6</span><span class="e7">]</span>

তুলসী দেখি’<span class="e25">	জুড়ায় প্রাণ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	মাধবতোষণী জানি’ ।<br /></span>গৌর-প্রিয়<span class="e25">	শাক সেবনে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	জীবন সার্থক মানি ॥৭॥</span>

[<span class="e24">7</span>]
(7<span class="e14">)</span> Seeing Tulasī Devī relieves my heart, for I know she is pleasing to Mādhava. By honouring śāk, a favourite of Śrī Gaurasundar, I consider my life successful.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">7</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> gaura-priya śāka: </span>“Śāk, a favourite of Śrī Gaurasundar.”

(Śrī Chaitanya-bhāgavat: Antya-līlā, 4.279)
“Śachī Devī knows the Lord is greatly pleased by śāk, preparations of leafy greens.”
ভকতিবিনোদ,<span class="e25">	কৃষ্ণভজনে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অনুকূল পায় যাহা ।<br /></span>প্রতি দিবসে,<span class="e25">	পরম সুখে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	স্বীকার করয়ে তাহা ॥৮॥</span>
bhakati-vinoda,<span class="e10">	kṛṣṇa-bhajane,<br /></span><span class="e11">	anukūla pāya yāhā<br /></span>prati-divase,<span class="e10">	parama-sukhe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	svīkāra karaye tāhā </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">8</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakati-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">bhajane</span>–for the service; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">pāya</span>–obtains; <span class="e2">yāhā</span>–whatever; <span class="e2">prati</span>–every; <span class="e2">divase</span>–on the day; <span class="e2">parama</span>–great; <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–with happiness; <span class="e2">svīkāra (aṅgīkāra)</span>–acceptance; <span class="e2">karaye</span>–does; <span class="e2">tāhā</span>–that.
