বেণু, শৃঙ্গ, পদচিহ্ণ, মেঘমালা ।<br />বসন্ত, শশাঙ্ক, শঙ্খ, করতাল ॥৫॥
veṇu, śṛṅga, pada-chihna, megha-mālā<br />vasanta, śaśāṅka, śaṅkha, karatāla <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">5</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">veṇu</span>–the six-inch whistling flute known as <span class="e3">veṇu</span>; <span class="e2">śṛṅga</span>–horn; <span class="e2">pada-chihna</span>–footprints (of the cows); <span class="e2">megha</span>–of clouds; <span class="e2">mālā</span>–rows; <span class="e2">vasanta</span>–springtime; <span class="e2">śaśāṅka</span>–moon; <span class="e2">śaṅkha</span>–conch; <span class="e2">karatāla</span>–hand-cymbals. [<span class="e24">5</span>]
(5<span class="e14">)</span> The veṇu flute, the buffalo-horn bugle, the footprints, the rows of clouds, the springtime, the moon, the conch, the kartāls …
যুগলবিলাসে অনুকূল জানি ।<br />লীলা-বিলাস-উদ্দীপক মানি ॥৬॥
yugala-vilāse anukūla jāni<br />līlā-vilāsa-uddīpaka māni <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">6</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">yugala</span>–of the Divine Couple; <span class="e2">vilāse</span>–within the Pastimes; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">jāni</span>–I know; <span class="e2">līlā-vilāsa</span>–Their Pastimes of love; <span class="e2">uddīpaka</span>–stimulate; <span class="e2">māni</span>–I know. [<span class="e24">6</span>]
(6<span class="e14">)</span> I know all of these things are favourable to the Divine Couple’s Pastimes. I know they all stimulate Their loving Pastimes.
এ সব ছোড়ত কাঁহা নাহি যাউঁ ।<br />এ সব ছোড়ত পরাণ হারাউঁ ॥৭॥
e saba chhoḍata kā̐hā nāhi yāu̐<br />e saba chhoḍata parāṇa hārāu̐ <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">7</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">e</span>–these; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">chhoḍata</span>–abandoning; <span class="e2">kā̐hā (kothāo)</span>–somewhere; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">yāu̐</span>–I will go; <span class="e2">e</span>–these; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">chhoḍata</span>–abandoning; <span class="e2">parāṇa</span>–my life; <span class="e2">hārāu̐ (hārāi)</span>–I will lose. [<span class="e24">7</span>]
(7<span class="e14">)</span> I will never abandon these things and go elsewhere. I will lose my life if I abandon these things.
ভকতিবিনোদ কহে শুন কান!<br />তুয়া উদ্দীপক হামার পরাণ ॥৮॥
bhakati-vinoda kahe śuna kāna!<br />tuyā uddīpaka hāmāra parāṇa <span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">8</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">bhakati-vinoda</span>–Bhakti Vinod; <span class="e2">kahe</span>–says; <span class="e2">śuna</span>–please listen; <span class="e2">kāna!</span>–O Kṛṣṇa!; <span class="e2">tuyā</span>–of You; <span class="e2">uddīpaka (smāraka vastu-samūha)</span>–stimulating (all things which cause remembrance); <span class="e2">hāmāra</span>–my; <span class="e2">parāṇa</span>–life and soul. [<span class="e24">8</span>]
(8<span class="e14">)</span> Bhakti Vinod says, “Please listen, O Kān! All these things that remind me of You are my life and soul.”

ভজন-লালসা
<span class="e2">Bhajana-Lālasā:</span> <br />Hankering for Service
(১)
(1)
হরি হে!<br />প্রপঞ্চে পড়িয়া,<span class="e25">	অগতি হইয়া,<br /></span><span class="e26">	না দেখি উপায় আর ।<br /></span>অগতির গতি,<span class="e25">	চরণে শরণ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	তোমায় করিনু সার ॥১॥</span>
<span class="e2">hari he!</span><br />prapañche paḍiyā,<span class="e10">	agati ha-iyā,<br /></span><span class="e11">	nā dekhi upāya āra<br /></span>agatira gati,<span class="e10">	charaṇe śaraṇa,<br /></span><span class="e11">	tomāya karinu sāra </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">hari</span>–Lord; <span class="e2">he</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">prapañche (pāñcha-bhautika jagate)</span>–in the material world (composed of the five gross elements, namely, earth, water, fire, air, and space); <span class="e2">paḍiyā</span>–falling; <span class="e2">agati (asatkṛta)</span>–helpless (a wrong-doer, one engaged in illusory activities); <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–becoming; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">dekhi</span>–I see; <span class="e2">upāya</span>–way; <span class="e2">āra</span>–another; <span class="e2">agatira</span>–of the shelterless; <span class="e2">gati</span>–the shelter (the Lord); <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet; <span class="e2">śaraṇa</span>–refuge; <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–in You; <span class="e2">karinu</span>–I did; <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the essence. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Lord! Having fallen into this material world and become wicked, I see no other means of deliverance. Shelter at Your feet is the only help for the helpless. I have accepted You as my be-all and end-all.
করম গেয়ান,<span class="e25">	কিছু নাহি মোর,<br /></span><span class="e26">	সাধন ভজন নাই ।<br /></span>তুমি কৃপাময়,<span class="e25">	আমি ত’ কাঙ্গাল,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অহৈতুকী কৃপা চাই ॥২॥</span>
karama geyāna,<span class="e10">	kichhu nāhi mora,<br /></span><span class="e11">	sādhana bhajana nāi<br /></span>tumi kṛpā-maya,<span class="e10">	āmi ta’ kāṅgāla,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ahaitukī kṛpā chāi </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">karama</span>–pious action; <span class="e2">geyāna</span>–knowledge; <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–something; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">mora</span>–mine; <span class="e2">sādhana</span>–devotional practice; <span class="e2">bhajana</span>–devotional service; <span class="e2">nāi</span>–there is no; <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You; <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">maya</span>–full of; <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I; <span class="e2">ta’</span>–certainly;<span class="e2"> kāṅgāla (ati dīna)</span>–poor (extremely fallen); <span class="e2">ahaitukī (yogyatā apekṣā nā kariyā)</span>–causeless (not depending on fitness); <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">chāi</span>–I desire. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> I perform no pious actions, I have no knowledge, I do not engage in any devotional practices, and I do not perform any devotional service. You are merciful, and I am most fallen. I pray for Your unconditional mercy.
বাক্য-মনো-বেগ,<span class="e25">	ক্রোধ-জিহ্বা-বেগ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	উদর-উপস্থ-বেগ ।<br /></span>মিলিয়া এ সব,<span class="e25">	সংসারে ভাসায়ে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	দিতেছে পরমোদ্বেগ ॥৩॥</span>
vākya-mana-vega,<span class="e10">	krodha-jihvā-vega,<br /></span><span class="e11">	udara-upastha-vega<br /></span>miliyā e saba,<span class="e10">	saṁsāre bhāsāye,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ditechhe paramodvega </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">vākya</span>–of speech; <span class="e2">mana</span>–of the mind; <span class="e2">vega</span>–the urges; <span class="e2">krodha</span>–of anger; <span class="e2">jihvā</span>–of the tongue; <span class="e2">vega</span>–the urges; <span class="e2">udara</span>–of the belly; <span class="e2">upastha</span>–and the genitals; <span class="e2">vega</span>–the urges; <span class="e2">miliyā</span>–meeting;<span class="e2"> e</span>–these; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">saṁsāre</span>–in the material world; <span class="e2">bhāsāye</span>–casting me adrift; <span class="e2">ditechhe</span>–have given; <span class="e2">paramodvega (dāruṇa duḥkha)</span>–great anxiety (severe distress). [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> </span>Uniting together and casting me adrift in the ocean of material existence, the urges of speech, the mind, anger, the tongue, the belly, and the genitals cause me terrible distress.
অনেক যতনে,<span class="e25">	সে সব দমনে<br /></span><span class="e26">	ছাড়িয়াছি আশা আমি ।<br /></span>অনাথের নাথ!<span class="e25">	ডাকি তব নাম,<br /></span><span class="e26">	এখন ভরসা তুমি ॥৪॥</span>
aneka yatane,<span class="e10">	se saba damane<br /></span><span class="e11">	chhāḍiyāchhi āśā āmi<br /></span>anāthera nātha!<span class="e10">	ḍāki taba nāma,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ekhana bharasā tumi </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">aneka</span>–numerous; <span class="e2">yatane</span>–by efforts;<span class="e2"> se</span>–they (these urges); <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">damane</span>–in subduing; <span class="e2">chhāḍiyāchhi</span>–have abandoned; <span class="e2">āśā</span>–hope; <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I; <span class="e2">anāthera</span>–of the helpless; <span class="e2">nātha!</span>–O Lord; <span class="e2">ḍāki</span>–I call; <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name; <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now; <span class="e2">bharasā</span>–shelter, hope; <span class="e2">tumi</span>–You. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> I have given up hope in subduing these urges by my own persistent endeavours. O Lord of the helpless! I call Your Name. You are now my only hope.
(1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the first verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī Upadeśāmṛta</span>:
vācho vegaṁ manasaḥ krodha-vegaṁ<br />jihvā-vegam udaropastha-vegam<br />etān vegān yo viṣaheta dhīraḥ<br />sarvām apīmāṁ pṛthivīṁ sa śiṣyāt
“A sober person who can control the urges of speech, the mind, anger, the tongue, the belly, and the genitals can also conquer the entire world.”
(২)
(2)
হরি হে!<br />অর্থের সঞ্চয়ে,<span class="e25">	বিষয়-প্রয়াসে<br /></span><span class="e26">	আন-কথা-প্রজল্পনে ।<br /></span>আন-অধিকার,<span class="e25">	নিয়ম আগ্রহে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অসৎসঙ্গ-সংঘটনে ॥১॥<br /></span>অস্থির সিদ্ধান্তে,<span class="e25">	রহিনু মজিয়া<br /></span><span class="e26">	হরি ভক্তি রৈল দূরে ।<br /></span>এ হৃদয়ে মাত্র,<span class="e25">	পরহিংসা মদ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	প্রতিষ্ঠা, শঠতা স্ফুরে ॥২॥</span>
hari he!<br />arthera sañchaye,<span class="e10">	viṣaya-prayāse</span><br /><span class="e11">	āna-kathā-prajalpane</span><br />āna-adhikāra,<span class="e10">	niyama-āgrahe,</span><br /><span class="e11">	asat-saṅga-saṁghaṭane </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span><br />asthira siddhānte,<span class="e10">	rahinu majiyā</span><br /><span class="e11">	hari-bhakti raila dūre</span><br />e hṛdaye mātra,<span class="e10">	para-hiṁsā mada,<br /></span><span class="e11">	pratiṣṭhā, śaṭhatā sphure </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">hari</span>–Lord; <span class="e2">he!</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">arthera</span>–of wealth; <span class="e2">sañchaye</span>–in accumulating; <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–for mundane ends; <span class="e2">prayāse (udyame)</span>–in endeavour; <span class="e2">āna (bāje)</span>–other (unnecessary); <span class="e2">kathā (kṛṣṇa-kathā vyātīta anya-kathā)</span>–talks (all talks other than those which relate to Kṛṣṇa); <span class="e2">prajalpane (vṛthā vākya-vyaye)</span>–in prattle (vain use of words); <span class="e2">āna</span>–for other; <span class="e2">adhikāra</span>–levels of qualification; <span class="e2">niyama</span>–prescriptions and prohibitions; <span class="e2">āgrahe (anyera adhikāragata niyama grahaṇa o nijādhikāragata niyama agrahaṇa vā varjana-kārye)</span>–in accepting (in accepting the prescriptions and prohibitions meant for those of other stages of spiritual advancement and rejecting the prescriptions and prohibitions meant for one’s own stage of advancement); <span class="e2">asat</span>–of non-devotees; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–association; <span class="e2">saṁghaṭane (asādhura saṅga grahaṇe)</span>–in joining with (in accepting the association of non-devotees); <span class="e2">asthira</span>–unsteady; <span class="e2">siddhānte (laulya, aniśchita vichāra)</span>–within conclusions (fickle-mindedness, indecision); <span class="e2">rahinu</span>–I remained; <span class="e2">majiyā (magna ha-iyā)</span>–being immersed; <span class="e2">hari-bhakti</span>–devotional service of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">raila (rahila)</span>–remained; <span class="e2">dūre</span>–far away; <span class="e2">e</span>–this; <span class="e2">hṛdaye</span>–in the heart; <span class="e2">mātra</span>–only; <span class="e2">para</span>–towards others; <span class="e2">hiṁsā</span>–malice; <span class="e2">mada (mattatā)</span>–madness (intoxication); <span class="e2">pratiṣṭhā (yaśolipsa)</span>–prestige (desiring fame); <span class="e2">śaṭhatā (dhūrtatā)</span>–insincerity (mischievousness); <span class="e2">sphure (sphurita haya)</span>–appear (are present). [<span class="e24">1</span>–<span class="e24">2</span>]
(1–2<span class="e14">)</span> O Lord! I have remained immersed in the defects of over-accumulating wealth, endeavouring for worldly ends, prattling about topics unrelated to You, acting in accordance with guidelines meant for others and disregarding guidelines meant for myself, associating with non-devotees, and being fickle-minded. Thus devotion to You has remained far away from me. Only malice towards others, pride, desire for worldly prestige, and insincerity flourish within my heart.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">1</span>–<span class="e2">2</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> asat-saṅga-saṁghaṭane: </span>“Associating with non-devotees.” Asat-saṅga, bad association, is defined in <span class="e3">Śrī Chaitanya-charitāmṛta </span>(Madhya-līlā, 22.84):
asat-saṅga-tyāga,—ei vaiṣṇava-āchāra<br />‘strī-saṅgī’—eka asādhu, ‘kṛṣṇābhakta’ āra
“Proper Vaiṣṇava behaviour is to reject bad association. There are two forms of bad association: the association of persons attached to the opposite sex and the association of persons who are not devotees of Kṛṣṇa.”
এ সব আগ্রহ,<span class="e25">	ছাড়িতে নারিনু,<br /></span><span class="e26">	আপন দোষেতে মরি ।<br /></span>জনম বিফল,<span class="e25">	হইল আমার,<br /></span><span class="e26">	এখন কি করি, হরি! ॥৩॥</span>
e saba āgraha,<span class="e10">	chhāḍite nārinu,<br /></span><span class="e11">	āpana doṣete mari<br /></span>janama biphala,<span class="e10">	ha-ila āmāra,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ekhana ki kari, hari! </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">e</span>–these; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all;<span class="e2"> āgraha (ākarṣaṇa)</span>–attachments (attractions); <span class="e2">chhāḍite</span>–to abandon; <span class="e2">nārinu</span>–I was not able; <span class="e2">āpana</span>–own; <span class="e2">doṣete</span>–by faults; <span class="e2">mari</span>–I die; <span class="e2">janama</span>–birth; <span class="e2">biphala</span>–fruitless; <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became; <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my; <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now; <span class="e2">ki</span>–what?; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">hari!</span>–O Lord! [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> I have not been able to abandon any of these attachments. I now die due to my own defects. My birth has become useless. O Lord! What should I do now?
আমি ত’ পতিত,<span class="e25">	পতিতপাবন<br /></span><span class="e26">	তোমার পবিত্র নাম ।<br /></span>সে সম্বন্ধ ধরি’,<span class="e25">	তোমার চরণে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	শরণ লইনু হাম ॥৪॥</span>
āmi ta’ patita,<span class="e10">	patita-pāvana<br /></span><span class="e11">	tomāra pavitra nāma<br /></span>se sambandha dhari’,<span class="e10">	tomāra charaṇe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	śaraṇa la-inu hāma </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">āmi</span>–I; <span class="e2">ta’</span>–certainly; <span class="e2">patita</span>–of the fallen; <span class="e2">pāvana</span>–saviour; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">pavitra</span>–purifying; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name; <span class="e2">se (sad-guru)</span>–that (perfect spiritual master); <span class="e2">sambandha</span>–relationship; <span class="e2">dhari’ (grahaṇa kariyā)</span>–holding (accepting); <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet; <span class="e2">śaraṇa</span>–shelter; <span class="e2">la-inu</span>–took; <span class="e2">hāma</span>–I. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> I am fallen. Your purifying Name is the saviour of the fallen. Embracing that relationship (through my relationship with Śrī Guru), I have taken shelter at Your feet.
(1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the second verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī Upadeśāmṛta</span>:
<span class="e2">atyāhāraḥ prayāsaś cha prajalpo niyamāgrahaḥ<br /></span>jana-saṅgaś cha laulyañcha ṣaḍbhir bhaktir vinaśyati
“Devotion is destroyed by these six defects: (1) over-accumulation; (2) materialistic endeavour; (3) unnecessary talk; (4) rejecting guidelines meant for one’s self and following guidelines meant for others; (5) association with non-devotees; and (6) fickle-mindedness.”

(3)
হরি হে!<br />ভজনে উৎসাহ,<span class="e25">	ভক্তিতে বিশ্বাস,<br /></span><span class="e26">	প্রেমলাভে ধৈর্য্য-ধন ।<br /></span>ভক্তি-অনুকূল,<span class="e25">	কর্ম্ম-প্রবর্ত্তনে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অসৎসঙ্গ-বিসর্জ্জন ॥১॥<br /></span>ভক্তি-সদাচার,<span class="e25">	এই ছয় গুণ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	নহিল আমার, নাথ!<br /></span>কেমনে ভজিব,<span class="e25">	তোমার চরণ<br /></span><span class="e26">	ছাড়িয়া মায়ার সাথ ॥২॥</span>
hari he!<br />bhajane utsāha,<span class="e10">	bhaktite viśvāsa,</span><br /><span class="e11">	prema-lābhe dhairya-dhana</span><br />bhakti-anukūla,<span class="e10">	karma-pravartane,</span><br /><span class="e11">	asat-saṅga-visarjana </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span><br />bhakti-sadāchāra,<span class="e10">	ei chhaya guṇa,</span><br /><span class="e11">	nahila āmāra, nātha!</span><br />kemane bhajiba,<span class="e10">	tomāra charaṇa</span><br /><span class="e11">	chhāḍiyā māyāra sātha </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">hari</span>–Lord; <span class="e2">he!</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">bhajane (śravaṇa-kīrtanādi bhaktyanuṣṭhāne)</span>–for devo­tional practice (for the devotional practices of hearing, chanting, and so forth); <span class="e2">utsāha</span>–enthusiasm; <span class="e2">bhaktite (bhakti-siddhānte)</span>–in devotional service (in the perfect conclusions of pure devotion); <span class="e2">viśvāsa (āsthā)</span>–faith (conviction); <span class="e2">prema (kṛṣṇa-prīti)</span>–of divine love (desire to lovingly satisfy Kṛṣṇa); <span class="e2">lābhe (sādhane)</span>–in the obtainment (in the process of obtaining); <span class="e2">dhairya</span>–of perseverance; <span class="e2">dhana</span>–the wealth; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–to devotional service; <span class="e2">anukūla</span>–favourable; <span class="e2">karma</span>–activities; <span class="e2">pravartana (pravṛtta haoyā)</span>–engagement in (to be engaged); <span class="e2">asat</span>–bad; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–association; <span class="e2">visarjana</span>–rejecting; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–of devo­tional service; <span class="e2">sat</span>–proper; <span class="e2">āchāra</span>–behaviour; <span class="e2">ei</span>–these; <span class="e2">chhaya</span>–six; <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–qualities; <span class="e2">nahila</span>–are not; <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–mine; <span class="e2">nātha!</span>–O Lord!; <span class="e2">kemane</span>–how?; <span class="e2">bhajiba</span>–I will serve; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">charaṇa</span>–feet; <span class="e2">chhāḍiyā</span>–abandoning; <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of illusion; <span class="e2">sātha</span>–association. [<span class="e24">1</span>–<span class="e24">2</span>]
(1–2<span class="e14">)</span> Enthusiasm for devotional practice, conviction in devotion, the wealth of perseverance in striving for prema, engagement in activities favourable to devotion, rejection of bad association, proper devotional behaviour—I have never had these six qualities. O Lord! How shall I serve Your feet and abandon the association of māyā?
গর্হিত আচারে,<span class="e25">	রহিলাম মজি’,<br /></span><span class="e26">	না করিনু সাধুসঙ্গ ।<br /></span>ল’য়ে সাধু-বেশ,<span class="e25">	আনে উপদেশি,<br /></span><span class="e26">	এ বড় মায়ার রঙ্গ ॥৩॥</span>
garhita āchāre,<span class="e10">	rahilāma maji’,<br /></span><span class="e11">	nā karinu sādhu-saṅga<br /></span>la’ye sādhu-veśa,<span class="e10">	āne upadeśi,<br /></span><span class="e11">	e baḍa māyāra raṅga </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">garhita (nindita)</span>–abominable (condemned); <span class="e2">āchāre (karme)</span>–in beha­viour (activities); <span class="e2">rahilāma</span>–I remained; <span class="e2">maji’</span>–being immersed; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">karinu</span>–I did; <span class="e2">sādhu</span>–of saintly devotees; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–association; <span class="e2">la’ye</span>–taking; <span class="e2">sādhu</span>–of a saintly devotee; <span class="e2">veśa</span>–the garb; <span class="e2">āne</span>–to others; <span class="e2">upadeśi</span>–advise; <span class="e2">e</span>–this; <span class="e2">baḍa</span>–great; <span class="e2">māyāra</span>–of illusion; <span class="e2">raṅga (vichitra khelā)</span>–trick (strange play). [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> I have remained immersed in offensive behaviour and never associated with sādhus. Yet I wear the garb of a sādhu and instruct others. This is a great trick of māyā.
এ হেন দশায়,<span class="e25">	অহৈতুকী কৃপা,<br /></span><span class="e26">	তোমার পাইব, হরি!<br /></span>শ্রীগুরু-আশ্রয়ে,<span class="e25">	ডাকিব তোমায়<br /></span><span class="e26">	কবে বা মিনতি করি’ ॥৪॥</span>
e hena daśāya,<span class="e10">	ahaitukī kṛpā,<br /></span><span class="e11">	tomāra pāiba, hari!<br /></span>śrī-guru-āśraye,<span class="e10">	ḍākiba tomāya<br /></span><span class="e11">	kabe vā minati kari’ </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">e</span>–this; <span class="e2">hena</span>–such; <span class="e2">daśāya</span>–in a condition; <span class="e2">ahaitukī</span>–causeless; <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–Your; <span class="e2">pāiba</span>–I will obtain; <span class="e2">hari!</span>–O Lord!; <span class="e2">śrī-guru</span>–of my spiri­tual master; <span class="e2">āśraye</span>–in the shelter; <span class="e2">ḍakiba</span>–I will call; <span class="e2">tomāya</span>–to You; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">vā</span>–<span class="e2">[</span>emphatic particle]; <span class="e2">minati</span>–prayer; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> In such a state, I will attain only Your unconditional mercy, O Lord! When will I prayerfully call out to You under the shelter of Śrī Guru?
(1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the third verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī Upadeśāmṛta</span>:
utsāhān niśchayād dhairyāt tat-tat-karma-pravartanāt<br />saṅga-tyāgāt sato vṛtteḥ ṣaḍbhir bhaktiḥ prasidhyati
“Devotion is nourished by these six qualities: (1) enthusiasm; (2) conviction; (3) perseverance; (4) engaging in activities that satisfy the Lord and His devotees; (5) abandoning all bad association and wrong attachment; and (6) following the behaviour prescribed by pure devotees.”

(4)
হরি হে!<br />দান, প্রতিগ্রহ,<span class="e25">	মিথো গুপ্তকথা,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ভক্ষণ ভোজন-দান ।<br /></span>সঙ্গের লক্ষণ—<span class="e25">	এই ছয় হয়,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ইহাতে ভক্তির প্রাণ ॥১॥</span>
hari he!<br />dāna, pratigraha,<span class="e10">	mitho gupta-kathā,</span><br /><span class="e11">	bhakṣaṇa bhojana-dāna</span><br />saṅgera lakṣaṇa—<span class="e10">	ei chhaya haya,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ihāte bhaktira prāṇa </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">hari</span>–Lord; <span class="e2">he!</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">dāna</span>–giving gifts; <span class="e2">pratigraha (dāna grahaṇa)</span>–accepting gifts; <span class="e2">mitho (paraspara)</span>–mutual; <span class="e2">gupta</span>–confidential; <span class="e2">kathā</span>–talks; <span class="e2">bhakṣaṇa</span>–partaking of foodstuffs; <span class="e2">bhojana</span>–foodstuffs; <span class="e2">dāna</span>–giving; <span class="e2">saṅgera</span>–of association; <span class="e2">lakṣaṇa</span>–the characteristics; <span class="e2">ei</span>–these; <span class="e2">chhaya</span>–six; <span class="e2">haya</span>–are; <span class="e2">ihāte</span>–in these; <span class="e2">bhaktira</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–the life. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Lord! Giving and accepting gifts, disclosing and listening to confidential matters, giving and partaking of foodstuffs—these are the six forms of loving association. The life-force of devotion abides within them.
তত্ত্ব না বুঝিয়ে,<span class="e25">	জ্ঞানে বা অজ্ঞানে<br /></span><span class="e26">	অসতে এ সব করি’ ।<br /></span>ভক্তি হারাইনু,<span class="e25">	সংসারী হইনু<br /></span><span class="e26">	সুদূরে রহিলে হরি ॥২॥</span>
tattva nā bujhiye,<span class="e10">	jñāne vā ajñāne<br /></span><span class="e11">	asate e saba kari’<br /></span>bhakti hārāinu,<span class="e10">	saṁsārī ha-inu<br /></span><span class="e11">	sudūre rahile hari </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">tattva</span>–this truth; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">bujhiye</span>–understanding; <span class="e2">jñāne</span>–in knowledge; <span class="e2">vā</span>–or; <span class="e2">ajñāne</span>–in ignorance; <span class="e2">asate</span>–with non-devotees, in a materialistic manner; <span class="e2">e</span>–these; <span class="e2">saba</span>–all; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–devotion; <span class="e2">hārāinu</span>–I lost; <span class="e2">saṁsārī</span>–a worldly person, a family man; <span class="e2">ha-inu</span>–I became; <span class="e2">sudūre</span>–very far away; <span class="e2">rahile</span>–remain; <span class="e2">hari</span>–the Lord. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> Not understanding this truth, and knowingly or unknowingly associating with non-devotees in all these ways, I have lost devotion and become a worldly person. The Lord has thus remained far away from me.
কৃষ্ণভক্ত জনে,<span class="e25">	এই সঙ্গ-লক্ষণে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	আদর করিব যবে ।<br /></span>ভক্তি-মহাদেবী,<span class="e25">	আমার হৃদয়-<br /></span><span class="e26">	আসনে বসিবে তবে ॥৩॥</span>
kṛṣṇa-bhakta-jane,<span class="e10">	ei saṅga-lakṣaṇe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ādara kariba yabe<br /></span>bhakti-mahādevī,<span class="e10">	āmāra hṛdaya-<br /></span><span class="e11">	āsane basibe tabe </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotee; <span class="e2">jane</span>–with persons; <span class="e2">ei</span>–these; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–of association; <span class="e2">lakṣaṇe</span>–characteristics; <span class="e2">ādara</span>–adore; <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when; <span class="e2">bhakti</span>–of devotion; <span class="e2">mahā</span>–great; <span class="e2">devī</span>–goddess; <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my; <span class="e2">hṛdaya</span>–of the heart; <span class="e2">āsane</span>–in the seat; <span class="e2">basibe</span>–will sit; <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> When I will adore Kṛṣṇa’s devotees through these six forms of association, the great goddess of devotion will sit upon the throne of my heart.
যোষিৎসঙ্গী জন,<span class="e25">	কৃষ্ণাভক্ত আর<br /></span><span class="e26">	দুহুঁ সঙ্গ পরিহরি’ ।<br /></span>তব ভক্তজন,<span class="e25">	সঙ্গ অনুক্ষণ<br /></span><span class="e26">	কবে বা হইবে হরি! ॥৪॥</span>
yoṣit-saṅgī jana,<span class="e10">	kṛṣṇābhakta āra<br /></span><span class="e11">	duhu̐-saṅga parihari’<br /></span>tava bhakta-jana,<span class="e10">	saṅga anukṣaṇa<br /></span><span class="e11">	kabe vā ha-ibe hari! </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">yoṣit-saṅgī (strī-saṅgī)</span>–those who mix with women; <span class="e2">jana</span>–persons; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇā­bhakta (kṛṣṇera abhakta arthāt bhakti-hīna—yathā māyāvādī, nirviśeṣavādī prabhṛti)</span>–those who are devoid of devotion to Kṛṣṇa (illusionists, impersonalists, materialists, and so on); <span class="e2">āra</span>–and; <span class="e2">duhu̐ (dui-janera)</span>–of these two persons; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–the association; <span class="e2">parihari’</span>–abandoning; <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your; <span class="e2">bhakta</span>–devotee; <span class="e2">jana</span>–persons; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–the association; <span class="e2">anukṣaṇa</span>–at every moment; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">vā</span>–[an emphatic particle]; <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be; <span class="e2">hari!</span>–O Lord! [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> O Lord! When will I abandon the association of both those who mix with the opposite sex and non-devotees, and constantly associate with Your devotees?
(1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the fourth verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī Upadeśāmṛta</span>:
dadāti pratigṛhṇāti guhyam ākhyāti pṛchchhati<br />bhuṅkte bhojayate chaiva ṣaḍ-vidhaṁ prīti-lakṣaṇam
“Giving and accepting gifts, expressing and enquiring about confidential matters, and giving and partaking of foodstuffs are the six forms of loving association.”

হরি হে!<br />সঙ্গদোষশূন্য,<span class="e25">	দীক্ষিতাদীক্ষিত,<br /></span><span class="e26">	যদি তব নাম গা’য় ।<br /></span>মানসে আদর,<span class="e25">	করিব তাঁহারে<br /></span><span class="e26">	জানি’ নিজ জন তায় ॥১॥</span>
hari he!<br />saṅga-doṣa-śūnya,<span class="e11">	dīkṣitādīkṣita,</span><br /><span class="e11">	yadi tava nāma gā’ya</span><br />mānase ādara,<span class="e10">	kariba tā̐hāre</span><br /><span class="e11">	jāni’ nija-jana tāya </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">hari</span>–Lord; <span class="e2">he!</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–association; <span class="e2">doṣa (asat)</span>–faulty (bad); <span class="e2">śūnya (mukta)</span>–free from; <span class="e2">dīkṣita (śrī guru-padāśrita)</span>–initiated (sheltered at the feet of Śrī Guru); <span class="e2">adīkṣita (tat-pūrvāvasthā prāpta)</span>–not initiated (situated in the preliminary stage prior to taking shelter of Śrī Guru); <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if; <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name; <span class="e2">gā’ya</span>–sings; <span class="e2">mānase</span>–within my heart; <span class="e2">ādara (tā̐hāra hṛdgata bhāvera prati samāna)</span>–honour (for their heartfelt faith and devotion); <span class="e2">kariba</span>–I will do; <span class="e2">tā̐hāre</span>–of them; <span class="e2">jāni’</span>–knowing; <span class="e2">nija</span>–own; <span class="e2">jana</span>–person; <span class="e2">tāya</span>–them. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Lord! If one free from bad association, be they initiated or yet to be initiated, sings Your Name, I will honour them within my heart, knowing them to be Yours.
দীক্ষিত হইয়া,<span class="e25">	ভজে তুয়া পদ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	তাঁহারে প্রণতি করি ।<br /></span>অনন্য-ভজনে,<span class="e25">	বিজ্ঞ যেই জন<br /></span><span class="e26">	তাঁহারে সেবিব হরি! ॥২॥</span>
dīkṣita ha-iyā,<span class="e10">	bhaje tuyā pada,<br /></span><span class="e11">	tā̐hāre praṇati kari<br /></span>ananya-bhajane,<span class="e10">	vijña yei jana<br /></span><span class="e11">	tā̐hāre seviba hari! </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">dīkṣita</span>–initiated; <span class="e2">ha-iyā</span>–being; <span class="e2">bhaje</span>–serves; <span class="e2">tuyā</span>–Your; <span class="e2">pada</span>–feet; <span class="e2">tā̐hāre (sad-guru padāśraye prakāśita bhakti-chihna bhaktake)</span>–to them (to a devo­tee who exhibits symptoms of devotion while sheltered at the feet of a true Guru); <span class="e2">praṇati (prakāśita maryādā dāna kariyā)</span>–bow (offering honour); <span class="e2">kari (kariba)</span>–I do (I will do); <span class="e2">ananya (aikāntika)</span>–unalloyed (sincere, whole­hearted); <span class="e2">bhajane (bhajanaśīlera)</span>–in devotional service (of devotional practice); <span class="e2">vijña</span>–expert; <span class="e2">yei</span>–who; <span class="e2">jana</span>–person; <span class="e2">tā̐hāre</span>–their; <span class="e2">seviba (sevā kariba)</span>–I will serve; <span class="e2">hari!</span>–O Lord! [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> I will offer my obeisance to anyone who has been initiated and serves Your feet. I will serve anyone who is expert in unalloyed devotional service, O Lord!
সর্ব্বভূতে সম,<span class="e25">	যে ভক্তের মতি<br /></span><span class="e26">	তাঁহার দর্শনে মানি ।<br /></span>আপনাকে ধন্য,<span class="e25">	সে সঙ্গ পাইয়া<br /></span><span class="e26">	চরিতার্থ হইলুঁ জানি ॥৩॥</span>

(4<span class="e14">)</span> When will I attain this sincere disposition towards Your devotees? When will I cross over this ocean of material existence and enter Your abode of Vraja?
(1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the fifth verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī Upadeśāmṛta</span>:
kṛṣṇeti yasya giri taṁ manasādriyeta<br />dīkṣāsti chet praṇatibhiś cha bhajantam īśam<br />śuśrūṣayā bhajana-vijñam ananyam anya-<br />nindādi-śūnya-hṛdam īpsita-saṅga-labdhyā
“One who chants Kṛṣṇa’s Name (the kaniṣṭha-adhikārī) should be honoured within the heart. One who is initiated and engaged in the Lord’s service (the madhyam-adhikārī) should be honoured with obeisance. One who is expert in devotion, who sees nothing apart from Kṛṣṇa, and whose heart is free from the duality of criticising and praising others (the uttam-adhikārī) should be considered most desirable association and honoured through submissive service.”

বৈষ্ণব-শরীর,<span class="e25">	অপ্রাকৃত সদা,<br /></span><span class="e26">	স্বভাব বপুর ধর্ম্মে ।<br /></span>কভু নহে জড়,<span class="e25">	তথাপি যে নিন্দে<br /></span><span class="e26">	পড়ে সে বিষমাধর্ম্ম ॥২॥</span>

<span class="e2">vaiṣṇava</span>–of a devotee; <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–the body; <span class="e2">aprākṛta (prakṛtira niyamera atīta)</span>–supramundane (beyond the laws of material nature); <span class="e2">sadā</span>–always; <span class="e2">svabhāva (nīcha-kula āvirbhāva, karkaśatā, vā ālasyādi svābhāvika doṣa)</span>–of the inborn nature (faults within their inborn nature, such as appearance within a low section of society, roughness [harshness or crassness], laziness, and so forth); <span class="e2">vapura (kadarya-varṇa, kugaṭhana, pīḍā-jarādi-janita kudarśana prabhṛti śarīra-gata doṣa)</span>–of the body (faults within their body, such as an unpleasant complexion, a deformed figure, disease, unsightliness as a result of age, and so forth); <span class="e2">dharme</span>–in the nature; <span class="e2">kabhu</span>–at any time; <span class="e2">nahe</span>–is not; <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–material; <span class="e2">tathāpi</span>–still; <span class="e2">ye</span>–who; <span class="e2">ninde</span>–blasphemes; <span class="e2">paḍe</span>–falls; <span class="e2">se</span>–they; <span class="e2">viṣama (gurutara)</span>–terrible (extremely heavy); <span class="e2">adharme</span>–into irreligion. (1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the sixth verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī</span> <span class="e3">Upadeśāmṛta</span>:

<span class="e2">chhaya</span>–the six; <span class="e2">vega</span>–urges; <span class="e2">dami’</span>–subduing; <span class="e2">chhaya</span>–the six; <span class="e2">doṣa</span>–defects; <span class="e2">śodhi’</span>–purifying; <span class="e2">chhaya</span>–the six; <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–qualities; <span class="e2">deha’</span>–please give; <span class="e2">dāse</span>–to this servant; <span class="e2">chhaya</span>–the six; <span class="e2">sat</span>–with devotees <span class="e2">saṅga</span>–forms of association; <span class="e2">deha’</span>–please give; <span class="e2">he</span>–oh; <span class="e2">āmāre</span>–to me; <span class="e2">basechhi</span>–I have sat; <span class="e2">saṅgera</span>–of association; <span class="e2">āśe</span>–with the desire. (2<span class="e14">)</span> Please subdue the six urges, purify me of the six defects, and give this servant the six qualities. Please grant me the six types of association. I have sat before you in hope of attaining that association.
(2<span class="e14">)</span> The six urges are those of speech, the mind, anger, the tongue, the belly, and the genitals. The six defects are over-accumulation, materialistic endeavour, unnecessary talk, rejecting the guidelines meant for one’s self and following guidelines meant for others, association with non-devotees, and fickle-mindedness or maintaining taste for sense gratification. The six good qualities are enthusiasm for devotional practice, conviction in devotion, perseverance in striving for prema, engagement in activities favourable to devotion, rejection of bad association, and proper devotional behaviour. The six forms of association are giving and accepting gifts, hearing about and discussing the service of the Lord, and partaking of and distributing mahāprasād.

(4<span class="e14">)</span> Kṛṣṇa is yours. You are able to give Kṛṣṇa; you have that power. I am very poor. Calling, ‘Kṛṣṇa!’ ‘Kṛṣṇa!’, I run after you.

hari he!<br />tomāre bhuliyā,<span class="e10">	avidyā-pīḍāya,</span><br /><span class="e11">	pīḍita rasanā mora</span><br />kṛṣṇa-nāma-sudhā,<span class="e10">	bhāla nāhi lāge,</span><br /><span class="e11">	viṣaya-sukhete bhora </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">hari</span>–Lord; <span class="e2">he!</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">tomāre</span>–about You; <span class="e2">bhuliyā</span>–forgetting; <span class="e2">avidyā</span>–of ignorance, averse to You; <span class="e2">pīḍāya</span>–with the disease jaundice, a condition which makes sweet taste bitter; <span class="e2">pīḍita</span>–afflicted; <span class="e2">rasanā</span>–tongue; <span class="e2">mora</span>–my; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name; <span class="e2">sudhā</span>–nectar; <span class="e2">bhāla</span>–good; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">lāge</span>–strikes; <span class="e2">viṣaya</span>–mundane; <span class="e2">sukhete</span>–in happiness; <span class="e2">bhora</span>–engrossed. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Lord! I have forgotten You, and my tongue has become afflic­ted with the jaundice of ignorance. Engrossed in mundane pleasures, my tongue does not like the nectar of Kṛṣṇa’s Name.
প্রতিদিন যদি,<span class="e25">	আদর করিয়া<br /></span><span class="e26">	সে নাম কীর্ত্তন করি ।<br /></span>সিতপল যেন,<span class="e25">	নাশি’ রোগ-মূল<br /></span><span class="e26">	ক্রমে স্বাদু হয়, হরি! ॥২॥</span>
prati-dina yadi,<span class="e10">	ādara kariyā<br /></span><span class="e11">	se nāma kīrtana kari<br /></span>sitapala yena,<span class="e10">	nāśi’ roga-mūla<br /></span><span class="e11">	krame svādu haya, hari! </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">prati</span>–every; <span class="e2">dina</span>–day; <span class="e2">yadi</span>–if; <span class="e2">ādara</span>–faith; <span class="e2">kariyā</span>–doing; <span class="e2">se</span>–that; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name; <span class="e2">kīrtana</span>–chanting, glorification; <span class="e2">kari</span>–I do; <span class="e2">sitapala (michhari)</span>–sugar candy; <span class="e2">yena</span>–like; <span class="e2">nāśi’</span>–destroying; <span class="e2">roga</span>–of the disease (jaundice); <span class="e2">mūla</span>–the root; <span class="e2">krame</span>–gradually; <span class="e2">svādu</span>–taste; <span class="e2">haya</span>–happens; <span class="e2">hari!</span>–O Hari! [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> Yet if I faithfully chant the Name every day, then, as sugar candy eradicates jaundice, so my taste for the Name will gradually develop, O Lord!
দুর্দ্দৈব আমার,<span class="e25">	সে নামে আদর,<br /></span><span class="e26">	না হইল, দয়াময়!<br /></span>দশ অপরাধ,<span class="e25">	আমার দুর্দ্দৈব,<br /></span><span class="e26">	কেমনে হইবে ক্ষয় ॥৩॥</span>
durdaiva āmāra,<span class="e10">	se nāme ādara,<br /></span><span class="e11">	nā ha-ila, dayāmaya!<br /></span>daśa aparādha,<span class="e10">	āmāra durdaiva,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kemane ha-ibe kṣaya </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">durdaiva (duṣkṛti, aparādha)</span>–misfortune (misbehaviour, offences); <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my; <span class="e2">se</span>–that; <span class="e2">nāme</span>–to the Name; <span class="e2">ādara</span>–love; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–happened; <span class="e2">dayāmaya</span>–merciful; <span class="e2">daśa</span>–ten; <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences; <span class="e2">āmāra</span>–my; <span class="e2">durdaiva</span>–misfortune; <span class="e2">kemane</span>–how?; <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be; <span class="e2">kṣaya</span>–destruction. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> My misfortune is that I have never had faith in the Name. O merciful Lord! How will the ten offences, my misfortune, be destroyed?
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">3</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> daśa aparādha:</span> “The ten offences.” Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur has defined the ten offences to Kṛṣṇa’s Name as follows: (1) to criticise sādhus devoted to the Name; (2) to consider the Names, Forms, Qualities, and Pastimes of the Supreme Lord to be distinct from Him, and to consider that Śiva and other demigods are Lords independent of the Supreme Lord; (3) to disrespect Śrī Guru, who enlightens others about the Name; (4) to disrespect the scriptures which narrate the Name’s glories; (5) to consider the Name’s glories to be nothing more than praise (to have no factual existence); (6) to consider the Name Himself to be imaginary; (7) to commit sin on the strength of the Name; (8) to consider ser­ving the Name to be equal to pious activity; (9) to instruct faithless persons about the Name; (10) to engage in the service of the Name with mundane egotism and possessiveness. These ten offences must be completely abandoned.
অনুদিন যেন,<span class="e25">	তব নাম গাই,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ক্রমেতে কৃপায় তব ।<br /></span>অপরাধ যা’বে,<span class="e25">	নামে রুচি হ’বে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	আস্বাদিব নামাসব ॥৪॥</span>
anudina yena,<span class="e10">	tava nāma gāi,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kramete kṛpāya tava<br /></span>aparādha yā’be,<span class="e10">	nāme ruchi ha’be,<br /></span><span class="e11">	āsvādiba nāmāsaba </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">anudina (nirantara)</span>–every day (incessantly); <span class="e2">yena</span>–as; <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–Name; <span class="e2">gāi</span>–I sing; <span class="e2">kramete</span>–gradually; <span class="e2">kṛpāya</span>–by mercy; <span class="e2">tava</span>–Your; <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences; <span class="e2">yā’be</span>–will go; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–for Your Name; <span class="e2">ruchi</span>–taste; <span class="e2">ha’be</span>–will be; <span class="e2">āsvādiba</span>–I will taste; <span class="e2">nāmāsaba (nāma-madhu)</span>–the nectar (honey) of Your Name. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> As I constantly chant Your Name, my offences will grad­ually go away by Your mercy. I will attain taste for Your Name, and I will relish Your Name’s nectar.
(1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the seventh verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī</span> <span class="e3">Upadeśāmṛta</span>:
syāt kṛṣṇa-nāma-charitādi-sitāpy avidyā-<br />pittopatapta-rasanasya na rochikā nu<br />kintv ādarād anudinaṁ khalu saiva juṣṭā<br />svādvī kramād bhavati tad-gada-mūla-hantrī
“Alas! Although Kṛṣṇa’s Name, Pastimes, and so forth are sweet like sugar candy, They are not relishable to a tongue severely afflicted by the jaundice of ignorance. Certainly, however, if They are inces­santly served with faith, They gradually become relishable and the jaundice of ignorance is eradicated.”

কৃষ্ণ-নাম-রূপ-<span class="e25">	গুণ-সুচরিত,<br /></span><span class="e26">	পরম যতনে করি’ ।<br /></span>রসনা-মানসে,<span class="e25">	করহ নিয়োগ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ক্রম-বিধি অনুসরি’ ॥২॥</span>
kṛṣṇa-nāma-rūpa-<span class="e10">	guṇa-sucharita,<br /></span><span class="e11">	parama yatane kari’<br /></span>rasanā-mānase,<span class="e10">	karaha niyoga,<br /></span><span class="e11">	krama-vidhi anusari’ </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Names; <span class="e2">rūpa</span>–Forms; <span class="e2">guṇa</span>–Qualities; <span class="e2">sucharita (aprākṛta-līlā)</span>–supramundane Pastimes; <span class="e2">parama</span>–great; <span class="e2">yatane</span>–with care; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">rasanā</span>–tongue; <span class="e2">mānase</span>–the mind; <span class="e2">karaha</span>–do; <span class="e2">niyoga</span>–engagement; <span class="e2">krama-vidhi</span>–the gradual process; <span class="e2">anusari’ (anusaraṇa kariyā)</span>–following. (<span class="e2">2</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> krama-vidhi: </span>“The gradual process of development.”<span class="e2"> </span>This refers to the stages of: śravaṇ-daśā, hearing; varaṇ-daśā, accepting; smaraṇ-daśā, meditating; āpan-daśā, attaining (svarūp-siddhi); and sampatti-daśā, supreme fortune (vastu-siddhi).
ব্রজে করি’ বাস,<span class="e25">	রাগানুগা হঞা,<br /></span><span class="e26">	স্মরণ কীর্তন কর ।<br /></span>এ নিখিল কাল,<span class="e25">	করহ যাপন<br /></span><span class="e26">	উপদেশ-সার ধর” ॥৩॥</span>

<span class="e2">hā!</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">rūpa-gosāñi</span>–Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu; <span class="e2">dayā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when; <span class="e2">dibe</span>–will give; <span class="e2">dīne</span>–to this beggar; <span class="e2">vraja</span>–in Vraja; <span class="e2">vāsa</span>–residence; <span class="e2">rāgātmika (vrajera nitya-siddha dāsa, sakhā, pitrādi o preyasīra gaṇa—ihārā rāgātmika jana)</span>–a devotee who by nature has deep loving attachment for the service of Kṛṣṇa (rāga) and who as a result is perpetually absorbed in the service of Kṛṣṇa (the eternally perfect residents of Vraja who serve Kṛṣṇa as His servants, friends, guardians, and lovers); <span class="e2">tumi</span>–you; <span class="e2">tava</span>–your; <span class="e2">pada</span>–the footsteps; <span class="e2">anuga</span>–following; <span class="e2">ha-ite</span>–to become; <span class="e2">dāsera</span>–of a servant; <span class="e2">āśā</span>–desire, aspiration. (1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the eighth verse of Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu’s <span class="e3">Śrī</span> <span class="e3">Upadeśāmṛta</span>:

“Having engaged one’s tongue and mind in the gradual process of chanting and remembering Kṛṣṇa’s Names, Forms, Qualities, and Pastimes, one should reside in Vraja and spend all of their time as a follower of those who have deep loving attachment to Kṛṣṇa. This is the essence of all instruction.”

[<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Gurudev! You have very mercifully given me a place in Śrī Godrumdwīp amid the forests of Gauḍa, and ordered me: “Reside in this abode which is non-different from Vraja and chant the Lord’s Name.”
কিন্তু কবে প্রভো,<span class="e25">	যোগ্যতা অর্পিবে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	এ দাসেরে দয়া করি’ ।<br /></span>চিত্ত স্থির হবে,<span class="e25">	সকল সহিব,<br /></span><span class="e26">	একান্তে ভজিব হরি ॥২॥</span>
kintu kabe prabho,<span class="e10">	yogyatā arpibe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	e dāsere dayā kari’<br /></span>chitta sthira habe,<span class="e10">	sakala sahiba,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ekānte bhajiba hari </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">kintu</span>–but; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">prabho</span>–O master; <span class="e2">yogyatā</span>–qualification; <span class="e2">arpibe</span>–you will give; <span class="e2">e</span>–this; <span class="e2">dāsere</span>–to the servant; <span class="e2">dayā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">chitta</span>–the heart; <span class="e2">sthira</span>–steadfast; <span class="e2">habe</span>–will be; <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all; <span class="e2">sahiba</span>–I will tolerate; <span class="e2">ekānte</span>–in a solitary place, sincerely; <span class="e2">bhajiba</span>–I will serve; <span class="e2">hari</span>–my Lord. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> But when, O master, will you mercifully grant this servant the qualification to do this? Then my heart will become steadfast, I will tolerate everything, and I will serve the Lord sin­cerely.
শৈশব-যৌবনে,<span class="e25">	জড়সুখ-সঙ্গে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অভ্যাস হইল মন্দ ।<br /></span>নিজকর্ম্ম-দোষে,<span class="e25">	এ দেহ হইল,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ভজনের প্রতিবন্ধ ॥৩॥</span>
śaiśava-yauvane,<span class="e10">	jaḍa-sukha-saṅge,<br /></span><span class="e11">	abhyāsa ha-ila manda<br /></span>nija-karma-doṣe,<span class="e10">	e deha ha-ila,<br /></span><span class="e11">	bhajanera pratibandha </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">śaiśava</span>–childhood; <span class="e2">yauvane</span>–in youth; <span class="e2">jaḍa</span>–material; <span class="e2">sukha</span>–happiness; <span class="e2">saṅge</span>–in association with; <span class="e2">abhyāsa</span>–habits; <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–were; <span class="e2">manda</span>–bad; <span class="e2">nija</span>–own; <span class="e2">karma</span>–actions; <span class="e2">doṣe</span>–by the fault; <span class="e2">e</span>–this; <span class="e2">deha</span>–body; <span class="e2">ha-ila</span>–became; <span class="e2">bhajanera</span>–to devotional service; <span class="e2">pratibandha (antarāya, vighna, bādhā)</span>–an obstacle (obstruction, hindrance, impediment). [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> In my childhood and youth, I was attached to material happiness and my habits were wicked. Now because of my sins this body has become an impediment to engagement in service.
বার্দ্ধক্যে এখন,<span class="e25">	পঞ্চরোগে হত,<br /></span><span class="e26">	কেমনে ভজিব বল’ ।<br /></span>কাঁদিয়া কাঁদিয়া,<span class="e25">	তোমার চরণে<br /></span><span class="e26">	পড়িয়াছি সুবিহ্বল ॥৪॥</span>
vārdhakye ekhana,<span class="e10">	pañcha-roge hata,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kemane bhajiba bala’<br /></span>kā̐diyā kā̐diyā,<span class="e10">	tomāra charaṇe<br /></span><span class="e11">	paḍiyāchhi suvihvala </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">vārdhakye</span>–in old age; <span class="e2">ekhana</span>–now; <span class="e2">pañcha (vividha)</span>–five (various); <span class="e2">roge</span>–by diseases; <span class="e2">hata</span>–attacked; <span class="e2">kemane</span>–how?; <span class="e2">bhajiba</span>–I will serve; <span class="e2">bala’</span>–please say; <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–weeping; <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–and weeping; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your; <span class="e2">charaṇe</span>–at the feet; <span class="e2">paḍiyāchhi</span>–I have fallen; <span class="e2">suvihvala</span>–greatly overwhelmed. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> Now aged, I am afflicted by various diseases. Tell me, how shall I serve? Crying incessantly, I have fallen at your feet, utterly overwhelmed.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">4</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> pañcha-roge:</span> “By various diseases.” This refers to a fivefold state of affliction (kleś): (1) avidyā: ignorance of one’s true identity as an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa; (2) asmitā: identification with the mundane ego, mind, and body; (3) abhiniveś: absorption in mundane exper­ience; (4) rāga: obsession with mundane pleasures and their paraphernalia; and (5) dveṣ: revulsion to dissatisfaction and its causes.
Alternately, <span class="e3">pañcha-roga</span> can refer to various forms of bodily diseases (such as diseases which impair one’s ability to see, hear, smell, taste, and touch).
(১১)
(11)
গুরুদেব!<br />কৃপাবিন্দু দিয়া,<span class="e25">	কর’ এই দাসে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	তৃণাপেক্ষা অতি দীন ।<br /></span>সকল সহনে,<span class="e25">	বল দিয়া কর’<br /></span><span class="e26">	নিজ মানে স্পৃহাহীন ॥১॥</span>
gurudeva!<br />kṛpā-bindu diyā,<span class="e10">	kara’ ei dāse,</span><br /><span class="e11">	tṛṇāpekṣā ati dīna</span><br />sakala sahane,<span class="e10">	bala diyā kara’</span><br /><span class="e11">	nija-māne spṛhā-hīna </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">gurudeva!</span>–O spiritual master!; <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–of mercy; <span class="e2">bindu</span>–a drop; <span class="e2">diyā</span>–giving; <span class="e2">kara’</span>–please make; <span class="e2">ei</span>–this; <span class="e2">dāse</span>–to the servant; <span class="e2">tṛṇa</span>–blade of grass; <span class="e2">apekṣā</span>–more than; <span class="e2">ati</span>–very; <span class="e2">dīna</span>–humble; <span class="e2">sakala</span>–all; <span class="e2">sahane</span>–for tolerating; <span class="e2">bala</span>–strength; <span class="e2">diyā</span>–giving; <span class="e2">kara’</span>–please make; <span class="e2">nija</span>–own; <span class="e2">māne</span>–for honour; <span class="e2">spṛhā</span>–desire; <span class="e2">hīna</span>–devoid. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Gurudev! Give this servant a drop of your mercy and make him more humble than a blade of grass. Give him the strength to tolerate everything, and make him free from any desire for personal honour.
সকলে সম্মান,<span class="e25">	করিতে শকতি,<br /></span><span class="e26">	দেহ’ নাথ! যথাযথ ।<br /></span>তবে ত’ গাইব,<span class="e25">	হরিনাম সুখে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অপরাধ হবে হত ॥২॥</span>
sakale sammāna,<span class="e10">	karite śakati,<br /></span><span class="e11">	deha’ nātha! yathāyatha<br /></span>tabe ta’ gāiba,<span class="e10">	hari-nāma sukhe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	aparādha ha’be hata </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">sakale</span>–to everyone; <span class="e2">sammāna</span>–honour;<span class="e2"> karite</span>–to do; <span class="e2">śakati</span>–the strength; <span class="e2">deha’</span>–please give; <span class="e2">nātha!</span>–O master!; <span class="e2">yathāyatha</span>–befittingly; <span class="e2">tabe</span>–then; <span class="e2">ta’</span>–certainly; <span class="e2">gāiba</span>–I will sing; <span class="e2">hari</span>–of the Lord; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name; <span class="e2">sukhe</span>–happily; <span class="e2">aparādha</span>–offences; <span class="e2">ha’be</span>–will be; <span class="e2">hata</span>–destroyed. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> O master! Give me the ability to befittingly honour everyone. Then I will sing the Lord’s Name happily, and all my offences will be eradicated.
কবে হেন কৃপা,<span class="e25">	লভিয়া এ জন,<br /></span><span class="e26">	কৃতার্থ হইবে, নাথ!<br /></span>শক্তিবুদ্ধিহীন,<span class="e25">	আমি অতি দীন,<br /></span><span class="e26">	কর’ মোরে আত্মসাথ ॥৩॥</span>
kabe hena kṛpā,<span class="e10">	labhiyā e jana,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kṛtārtha ha-ibe, nātha!<br /></span>śakti-buddhi-hīna,<span class="e10">	āmi ati dīna,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kara’ more ātma-sātha </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">hena</span>–such; <span class="e2">kṛpā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">labhiyā</span>–obtaining; <span class="e2">e</span>–this; <span class="e2">jana</span>–person; <span class="e2">kṛtārtha</span>–fulfilled; <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be; <span class="e2">nātha!</span>–O master!; <span class="e2">śakti</span>–strength; <span class="e2">buddhi</span>–and intelligence; <span class="e2">hīna</span>–devoid; <span class="e2">āmi</span>–I; <span class="e2">ati</span>–greatly; <span class="e2">dīna</span>–distressed; <span class="e2">kara’</span>–please do; <span class="e2">more</span>–to me; <span class="e2">ātma</span>–self; <span class="e2">sātha</span>–with. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> When will this soul attain such mercy and become fulfilled? O master! I am devoid of ability and intelligence, and greatly distressed. Please accept me as your own.
যোগ্যতা-বিচারে,<span class="e25">	কিছু নাহি পাই,<br /></span><span class="e26">	তোমার করুণা সার ।<br /></span>করুণা না হৈলে,<span class="e25">	কাঁদিয়া কাঁদিয়া,<br /></span><span class="e26">	প্রাণ না রাখিব আর ॥৪॥</span>
yogyatā-vichāre,<span class="e10">	kichhu nāhi pāi,<br /></span><span class="e11">	tomāra karuṇā—sāra<br /></span>karuṇā nā haile,<span class="e10">	kā̐diyā kā̐diyā,<br /></span><span class="e11">	prāṇa nā rākhiba āra </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">yogyatā</span>–fitness; <span class="e2">vichāre</span>–in considering; <span class="e2">kichhu</span>–anything; <span class="e2">nāhi</span>–not; <span class="e2">pāi</span>–I obtain; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your; <span class="e2">karuṇā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">sāra</span>–the essence; <span class="e2">karuṇā</span>–merciful; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">haile</span>–if you are; <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–crying; <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–and crying; <span class="e2">prāṇa</span>–life; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">rākhiba</span>–I will maintain; <span class="e2">āra</span>–any more. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> When I examine my qualifications, I find none. Your mercy is everything. If you are not merciful to me, then, crying incessantly, I will not live any longer.
(1–4<span class="e14">)</span> This song is based on the third verse of Śrīman Mahāprabhu’s <span class="e3">Śikṣāṣṭakam</span>:
tṛṇād api sunīchena taror iva sahiṣṇunā<br />amāninā mānadena kīrtanīyaḥ sadā hariḥ
“The Lord’s Name is always to be chanted with more humility than a blade of grass, tolerance like that of a tree, respect for everyone, and without desire for respect from anyone.”
(১২)
(12)
<span class="e26">	গুরুদেব! কবে মোর সেই দিন হবে ।<br /></span>মন স্থির করি’,<span class="e25">	নির্জ্জনে বসিয়া,<br /></span><span class="e26">	কৃষ্ণনাম গাব যবে ।<br /></span>সংসার-ফুকার,<span class="e25">	কাণে না পশিবে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	দেহ-রোগ দূরে রবে ॥১॥</span>
<span class="e11">	gurudeva! kabe mora sei dina ha’be</span><span class="e6"><br /></span>mana sthira kari’,<span class="e10">	nirjane vasiyā,</span><span class="e5"><br /></span><span class="e11">	kṛṣṇa-nāma gāba yabe</span><span class="e6"><br /></span>saṁsāra-phukāra,<span class="e10">	kāṇe nā paśibe,</span><span class="e5"><br /></span><span class="e11">	deha-roga dūre rabe </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">gurudeva!</span>–O spiritual master!; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?;<span class="e2"> mora</span>–mine; <span class="e2">sei</span>–that; <span class="e2">dina</span>–day; <span class="e2">ha’be</span>–will be; <span class="e2">mana</span>–mind; <span class="e2">sthira</span>–steady; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">nirjane</span>–in a solitary place; <span class="e2">vasiyā</span>–residing; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name; <span class="e2">gāba</span>–I will sing; <span class="e2">yabe</span>–when; <span class="e2">saṁsāra</span>–of the material world; <span class="e2">phukāra (kolāhala)</span>–loud shouting (confused noise); <span class="e2">kāṇe</span>–in the ear; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">paśibe</span>–will enter; <span class="e2">deha</span>–of the material body; <span class="e2">roga (smṛti)</span>–disease (remembrance); <span class="e2">dūre</span>–far away; <span class="e2">rabe</span>–will remain. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Gurudev! When will that day be mine, when I will steady my mind, reside in a solitary place, and chant Kṛṣṇa’s Name? Then all the cacophony of the material world will no longer enter my ears, and the disease of bodily consciousness will remain far away from me.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">1</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> nirjane: </span>“In a solitary place.” In this connection Śrīla Bhakti Siddhānta Saraswatī Ṭhākur has written in his poem <span class="e3">Vaiṣṇava Ke?</span>:
kīrtana prabhāve,<span class="e17">	smaraṇa ha-ibe,<br /></span><span class="e18">	se kāle bhajana nirjana sambhava</span>
“The practice of kīrtan results in the qualification to serve the Lord in meditation (smaraṇ). Only at that time is service to the Lord in solitude possible.”
‘হরে কৃষ্ণ’ বলি’,<span class="e25">	গাহিতে গাহিতে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	নয়নে বহিবে লোর ।<br /></span>দেহেতে পুলক,<span class="e25">	উদিত হইবে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	প্রেমেতে করিবে ভোর ॥২॥</span>
‘hare kṛṣṇa’ bali’,<span class="e10">	gāhite gāhite,<br /></span><span class="e11">	nayane bahibe lora<br /></span>dehete pulaka,<span class="e10">	udita ha-ibe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	premete karibe bhora </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">‘hare kṛṣṇa’</span>–O Rādhā! O Kṛṣṇa!;<span class="e2"> bali’</span>–calling; <span class="e2">gāhite</span>–chanting; <span class="e2">gāhite</span>–and chanting; <span class="e2">nayane</span>–from my eyes; <span class="e2">bahibe</span>–will flow;<span class="e2"> lora (aśru)</span>–tears;<span class="e2"> dehete</span>–in the body; <span class="e2">pulaka (romāñcha)</span>–horripilation (ecstasy); <span class="e2">udita</span>–rise; <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be; <span class="e2">premete</span>–with divine love; <span class="e2">karibe</span>–will do; <span class="e2">bhora</span>–overcome. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> Chanting continuously, I will call out, “Hare Krṣṇa”, tears will flow from my eyes, the hair of my body will stand on end, and I will be overwhelmed with prema.
গদ-গদ বাণী,<span class="e25">	মুখে বাহিরিবে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	কাঁপিবে শরীর মম ।<br /></span>ঘর্ম্ম মুহুর্মুহুঃ,<span class="e25">	বিবর্ণ হইবে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	স্তম্ভিত প্রলয়-সম ॥৩॥</span>
gada-gada vāṇī,<span class="e10">	mukhe vāhiribe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kā̐pibe śarīra mama<br /></span>gharma muhur-muhuḥ,<span class="e10">	vivarṇa ha-ibe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	stambhita pralaya-sama </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">gada-gada</span>–faltering; <span class="e2">vāṇī</span>–utterances; <span class="e2">mukhe</span>–from my mouth; <span class="e2">vāhiribe</span>–will come out; <span class="e2">kā̐pibe</span>–will tremble; <span class="e2">śarīra</span>–body; <span class="e2">mama</span>–my; <span class="e2">gharma</span>–pers­piration; <span class="e2">muhuḥ</span>–again; <span class="e2">muhuḥ</span>–and again; <span class="e2">vivarṇa</span>–turning pale; <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be; <span class="e2">stambhita</span>–stunned; <span class="e2">pralaya</span>–devastation; <span class="e2">sama</span>–like. [<span class="e24">3</span>]
(3<span class="e14">)</span> Faltering utterances will issue from my mouth. My body will tremble, perspire again and again, turn pale, and become stunned as though devastated.
নিষ্কপটে হেন,<span class="e25">	দশা কবে হ’বে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	নিরন্তর নাম গাব ।<br /></span>আবেশে রহিয়া,<span class="e25">	দেহযাত্রা করি’<br /></span><span class="e26">	তোমার করুণা পাব ॥৪॥</span>
niṣkapaṭe hena,<span class="e10">	daśā kabe ha’be,<br /></span><span class="e11">	nirantara nāma gāba<br /></span>āveśe rahiyā,<span class="e10">	deha-yātrā kari’<br /></span><span class="e11">	tomāra karuṇā pāba </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">niṣkapaṭe</span>–without deceit, sincerely; <span class="e2">hena</span>–such; <span class="e2">daśā</span>–condition, state of ecstasy; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">ha’be</span>–will be; <span class="e2">nirantara</span>–incessantly; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Name; <span class="e2">gāba</span>–I will chant; <span class="e2">āveśe</span>–in ecstasy; <span class="e2">rahiyā</span>–remaining; <span class="e2">deha</span>–of the body; <span class="e2">yātrā</span>–maintenance; <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">tomāra</span>–your; <span class="e2">karuṇā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">pāba</span>–I will obtain. [<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> When will I genuinely experience such a state? Then I will chant the Name incessantly. Remaining rapt in ecstasy and somehow or other maintaining my body, I will receive your mercy.
(2–4<span class="e14">)</span> Offenceless chanting of the Lord’s Names results in the appearance of supramundane transformations of spiritual ecstasy. This is mentioned in <span class="e3">Śrī Chaitanya-charitāmṛta </span>(Antya-līlā, 4.71):
tāra madhye sarva-śreṣṭha nāma-saṅkīrtana<br />niraparādhe nāma laile pāya prema-dhana
“Among the nine forms of devotional service, Nām-saṅkīrtan is supreme. If one chants the Lord’s Name without offence, he attains the wealth of prema.”
There are eight primary transformations of spiritual ecstasy (aṣṭa-sāttvika vikār): (1) stambha, stupefaction; (2) sved, perspiration; (3) romāñcha, horripilation; (4) svara-bhed, faltering of the voice; (5) kampa, trembling; (6) vaivarṇya, pallor; (7) aśru, tears; and (8) pralaya (mūrchchhā), devastation (fainting).
(১৩)
(13)
<span class="e26">	গুরুদেব! কবে তব করুণা প্রকাশে ।<br /></span>শ্রীগৌরাঙ্গলীলা,<span class="e25">	হয় নিত্যতত্ত্ব,<br /></span><span class="e26">	এই দৃঢ় বিশ্বাসে ।<br /></span>‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ বলি’,<span class="e25">	গোদ্রুম-কাননে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ভ্রমিব দর্শন আশে ॥১॥</span>

<span class="e2">gurudeva!</span>–O spiritual master!; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">tava</span>–your; <span class="e2">karuṇā</span>–mercy; <span class="e2">prakāśe</span>–by the manifestation; <span class="e2">śrī-gaurāṅga</span>–of Śrīman Mahāprabhu; <span class="e2">līlā</span>–the Pastimes; <span class="e2">haya</span>–become; <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal; <span class="e2">tattva</span>–truth; <span class="e2">ei</span>–this; <span class="e2">dṛḍha</span>–firm; <span class="e2">viśvāse</span>–with faith; <span class="e2">hari</span>–Name of ‘Hari’; <span class="e2">hari</span>–Name of ‘Hari’; <span class="e2">bali’</span>–calling; <span class="e2">godruma</span>–of the island known as ‘Godrum’; <span class="e2">kānane</span>–in the forest; <span class="e2">bhramiba</span>–I will wander; <span class="e2">darśana (bahir-darśana)</span>–to see (to see outwardly before me); <span class="e2">āśe</span>–with the desire. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> O Gurudev! When, by the manifestation of your mercy, will I have firm faith in the eternal truth of Śrī Gaurāṅga’s Pastimes, and wander amid the forest of Śrī Godrumdwīp calling out, “Hari!” “Hari!” in hope of beholding those Pastimes before me?
নিতাই গৌরাঙ্গ,<span class="e25">	অদ্বৈত শ্রীবাস,<br /></span><span class="e26">	গদাধর পঞ্চজন ।<br /></span>কৃষ্ণনাম-রসে,<span class="e25">	ভাসা’বে জগৎ,<br /></span><span class="e26">	করি’ মহাসংকীর্ত্তন ॥২॥</span>
nitāi gaurāṅga,<span class="e10">	advaita śrīvāsa,<br /></span><span class="e11">	gadādhara pañcha-jana<br /></span>kṛṣṇa-nāma-rase,<span class="e10">	bhāsā’be jagat,<br /></span><span class="e11">	kari’ mahā-saṅkīrtana </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">nitāi</span>–Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu; <span class="e2">gaurāṅga</span>–Śrīman Mahāprabhu; <span class="e2">advaita</span>–Śrī Advaita Prabhu; <span class="e2">śrīvāsa</span>–Śrīvās Ṭhākur; <span class="e2">gadādhara</span>–Gadādhar Paṇḍit; <span class="e2">pañcha</span>–five; <span class="e2">jana</span>–persons; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–of Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">nāma</span>–the Names; <span class="e2">rase</span>–with the nectar; <span class="e2">bhāsā’be</span>–will make float; <span class="e2">jagat (bhuvana)</span>–the universe (the world); <span class="e2">kari’</span>–doing; <span class="e2">mahā</span>–great; <span class="e2">saṅkīrtana</span>–congregational chanting. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, Śrī Gaurāṅga Mahāprabhu, Śrī Advaita Prabhu, Śrī Śrīvās Ṭhākur, and Śrī Gadādhar Paṇḍit—these five great personages will inundate the world with the rasa of Kṛṣṇa’s Name by performing mahāsaṅkīrtan.
নর্ত্তন-বিলাস,<span class="e25">	মৃদঙ্গ-বাদন,<br /></span><span class="e26">	শুনিব আপন-কাণে ।<br /></span>দেখিয়া দেখিয়া,<span class="e25">	সে লীলা-মাধুরী,<br /></span><span class="e26">	ভাসিব প্রেমের বানে ॥৩॥</span>
nartana-vilāsa,<span class="e10">	mṛdaṅga-vādana,<br /></span><span class="e11">	śuniba āpana-kāṇe<br /></span>dekhiyā dekhiyā,<span class="e10">	se līlā-mādhurī,<br /></span><span class="e11">	bhāsiba premera vāne </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">3</span><span class="e7">]</span>

(3<span class="e14">)</span> I will hear with my own ears the sounds of the mṛdaṅga and the movements of Their dancing. Beholding the sweet beauty of such Pastimes, I will float in a flood of prema.
না দেখি’ আবার,<span class="e25">	সে লীলা-রতন,<br /></span><span class="e26">	কাঁদি ‘হা গৌরাঙ্গ!’ বলি’ ।<br /></span>আমারে বিষয়ী,<span class="e25">	‘পাগল’ বলিয়া,<br /></span><span class="e26">	অঙ্গেতে দিবেক ধূলি ॥৪॥</span>

[<span class="e24">4</span>]
(4<span class="e14">)</span> Again, not seeing those jewel-like Pastimes before me, I will cry, calling out, “O Gaurāṅga!” Considering me a madman, materialists will kick dust upon my body.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">4</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> ‘pāgala’ baliyā: “</span>Considering me a madman.” Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭāchārya has similarly declared:
parivadatu jano yathā tathāyaṁ<br />nanu mukharo na vayaṁ vichārayāmaḥ<br />hari-rasa-madirā-madātimattā<br />bhuvi viluṭhāma naṭāma nirviśāmaḥ
(Padyāvalī: 73)
“Let the garrulous masses criticise us howsoever they please; we will not consider their words. Wildly intoxicated by drinking the wine of the rasa of the Lord, we will dance, roll on the ground, and faint.”

kabe gaura-vane,<span class="e10">	suradhunī-taṭe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	‘hā rādhe hā kṛṣṇa’ bale’<br /></span>kā̐diyā beḍāba,<span class="e10">	deha-sukha chhāḍi’<br /></span><span class="e11">	nānā latā-taru-tale </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">gaura (śrī gaurasundarer)</span>–of Śrī Gaurasundar; <span class="e2">vane (vihāra-kṣetre)</span>–in the forest (in the place of the Pastimes of Śrī Gaurasundar—Śrī Nabadwīp Dhām); <span class="e2">suradhunī</span>–of the Ganges; <span class="e2">taṭe</span>–on the bank; <span class="e2">hā</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">rādhe</span>–Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; <span class="e2">hā</span>–oh!; <span class="e2">kṛṣṇa</span>–Kṛṣṇa; <span class="e2">bale</span>–say; <span class="e2">kā̐diyā</span>–crying; <span class="e2">beḍāba</span>–I will wander; <span class="e2">deha</span>–of the body; <span class="e2">sukha</span>–happiness; <span class="e2">chhāḍi’</span>–abandoning; <span class="e2">nānā</span>–various; <span class="e2">latā</span>–creepers; <span class="e2">taru</span>–trees; <span class="e2">tale</span>–at the base. গৌড়-ব্রজ-জনে,<span class="e25">	ভেদ না হেরিব,<br /></span><span class="e26">	হইব বরজবাসী ।<br /></span>ধামের স্বরূপ,<span class="e25">	স্ফুরিবে নয়নে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	হইব রাধার দাসী ॥৪॥</span>
gauḍa-vraja-jane,<span class="e10">	bheda nā heriba,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ha-iba varaja-vāsī<br /></span>dhāmera svarūpa,<span class="e10">	sphuribe nayane,<br /></span><span class="e11">	ha-iba rādhāra dāsī </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">4</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">gauḍa (śrī-gauḍa-maṇḍala)</span>–of the district of Gauḍa; <span class="e2">vraja (śrī vraja-maṇḍala)</span>–of the district of Vraja; <span class="e2">jane (parikara, bhagavat pārṣada)</span>–the people (retinue, associates of the Lord); <span class="e2">bheda</span>–difference; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">heriba</span>–I will see; <span class="e2">ha-iba</span>–I will become; <span class="e2">varaja (vraja)</span>–of Vraja; <span class="e2">vāsī</span>–a resident; <span class="e2">dhāmera</span>–of the abode (of Vraja); <span class="e2">svarūpa (chidānanda svarūpa)</span>–the true nature (ecstatic spiritual nature); <span class="e2">sphuribe</span>–will be manifest; <span class="e2">nayane</span>–before my eyes; <span class="e2">ha-iba (lābha kariba)</span>–I will become (I will obtain); <span class="e2">rādhāra</span>–of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; <span class="e2">dāsī (kaiṅkarya)</span>–a maidservant (servitude). (4<span class="e14">)</span> I will see no difference between the residents of Gauḍa and the residents of Vraja, and I will become a resident of Vraja. The true nature of the Lord’s abode will manifest before my eyes, and I will become Śrī Rādhā’s maidservant.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">4</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> gauḍa-vraja-jane:</span> “The residents of Gauḍa and the residents of Vraja.” In this connection, Śrīla Narottam Ṭhākur has written in his composition <span class="e3">Prārthanā </span>(39.3):
śrī-gauḍa-maṇḍala-bhūmi,<span class="e5">	yebā jāne chintāmaṇi,</span><br /><span class="e6">	tāra haya vraja-bhūme vāsa</span>
“One who knows the land of Śrī Gauḍa to be made of wish-fulfilling jewels (that is, to be spiritual) resides in the land of Vraja.”

(15)
দেখিতে দেখিতে,<span class="e25">	ভুলিব বা কবে,<br /></span><span class="e26">	নিজ-স্থূল-পরিচয় ।<br /></span>নয়নে হেরিব,<span class="e25">	ব্রজপুরশোভা,<br /></span><span class="e26">	নিত্য চিদানন্দময় ॥১॥</span>
dekhite dekhite,<span class="e10">	bhuliba vā kabe,<br /></span><span class="e11">	nija-sthūla-parichaya<br /></span>nayane heriba,<span class="e10">	vraja-pura-śobhā,<br /></span><span class="e11">	nitya chid-ānanda-maya </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">1</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">dekhite</span> <span class="e2">dekhite</span>–immediately; <span class="e2">bhuliba</span>–I will forget; <span class="e2">vā</span>–[an emphatic particle]; <span class="e2">kabe</span>–when?; <span class="e2">nija</span>–own; <span class="e2">sthūla (jaḍa jagatera)</span>–gross (of the material world); <span class="e2">parichaya</span>–identity; <span class="e2">nayane</span>–in the eyes; <span class="e2">heriba</span>–I will behold; <span class="e2">vraja</span>–of Vraja; <span class="e2">pura</span>–the village; <span class="e2">śobhā</span>–the beauty; <span class="e2">nitya</span>–eternal; <span class="e2">chit</span>–spiritual; <span class="e2">ānanda</span>–ecstasy; <span class="e2">maya</span>–consisting of. [<span class="e24">1</span>]
(1<span class="e14">)</span> When will I at once forget my gross material identity? Then I will behold before my eyes the beauty of the eternal, spiritual, ecstatic abode of Vraja.
বৃষভানুপুরে,<span class="e25">	জনম লইব,<br /></span><span class="e26">	যাবটে বিবাহ হ’বে ।<br /></span>ব্রজগোপী-ভাব,<span class="e25">	হইবে স্বভাব,<br /></span><span class="e26">	আন-ভাব না রহিবে ॥২॥</span>
vṛṣabhānu-pure,<span class="e10">	janama la-iba,<br /></span><span class="e11">	yāvaṭe vivāha ha’be<br /></span>vraja-gopī-bhāva,<span class="e10">	ha-ibe svabhāva,<br /></span><span class="e11">	āna-bhāva nā rahibe </span><span class="e15">[</span><span class="e16">2</span><span class="e7">]</span>
<span class="e2">vṛṣabhānu</span>–of King Vṛṣabhānu (the father of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī); <span class="e2">pure</span>–in the village; <span class="e2">janama</span>–birth; <span class="e2">la-iba</span>–I will take; <span class="e2">yāvaṭe (śrī rādhārāṇīra</span> <span class="e2">śvaśurālaye)</span>–in the village of Yāvaṭ (in the abode of the father-in-law of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī); <span class="e2">vivāha</span>–wedding; <span class="e2">ha’be</span>–will be; <span class="e2">vraja</span>–of Vraja; <span class="e2">gopī</span>–cowherd lady; <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–nature, identity, mood; <span class="e2">ha-ibe</span>–will be; <span class="e2">svabhāva</span>–nature; <span class="e2">āna (gopī-bhinna anya)</span>–another (different from that of a gopī); <span class="e2">bhāva</span>–nature; <span class="e2">nā</span>–not; <span class="e2">rahibe</span>–will remain. [<span class="e24">2</span>]
(2<span class="e14">)</span> I will take birth in the village of Vṛṣabhānu and be married in the village of Yāvaṭ. My nature will become that of a Vraja-gopī; no other nature will remain within me.
<span class="e7">(</span><span class="e2">2</span><span class="e14">)</span><span class="e2"> vṛṣabhānu-pure … āna-bhāva nā rahibe:</span> “I will take birth in the village of Vṛṣabhānu … No other nature will remain within me.” Śrīla Narottam Ṭhākur has written a verse similar to this in <span class="e3">Prārthanā </span>(12.1–2):
